description: The mysterious shopkeeper signed a dream-like agreement with the young lass, Amiya, hoping that she would be able to deliver love and piping-hot food to every customer.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Fresh Fastener. An outfit worn by Amiya while working for a Rhodes Island restaurant. This poofy coat is cold-resistant, and has enough room to hold something penguin-sized.

description: Planting, fostering, all for tomorrow.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Seedsower. A loose yet comfortable outdoors fit. Comes with an exclusive miniature mountain-grade rucksack and an agricultural nursery kit. The designer has one small wish of her own, and hopes that we can all help to realize it.

description: The sky of Londinium is always gray.
dialog: Test Collection/Newsgirl. Available only in certain regions, this remake of a classic design utilizes the best materials and contains carefully-sewn details. An extra custom-made letter opener is included.

description: 她曾梦见过星星的模样。那群星长眠的深空彼岸，或许有一日会留下她的足迹。
dialog: 由阿米娅参与设计的CASC合作服装/触及星辰。配备精密的生命保障系统，兼顾维生性能与舒适性，足以应对外层空间的极端环境。

description: 'Doctor, time still flows as I move forward. I don't yet know what the outcome will be, but I trust that with you, we will reach the most perfect one.'
dialog: Test Collection Series/In A Myriad of Universes. A journey of pursuit embarked upon by Amiya. Perhaps uncontrolled Originium destroys an entire world, but across countless universes, she will ultimately find you, find hope.

description: She draws the bow slowly, gently whispering her wishes. Though not a single note has ever changed, her audience, her stage, and she herself have been constantly evolving. She will not stop playing, until this land and sky hold her music in their memory.
dialog: Test Birthday Collection 1101/Solo Around The World. The Ark cradling the cocoon of dreams sailed into the galaxy, dissolving into millions of threads. With love as their needle, the many hands crafted a one-of-a-kind garment for Amiya. The remaining threads, intertwined with wishes, were fashioned into a violin.

description: 'I'm Kal'tsit, a doctor of Rhodes Island, and also the companion of Amiya and the Doctor. You have long been worthless to me.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Remnant. Originium has taken over the land, and what she envisioned has become a reality. She has enumerated and entrusted everything else to the others, leaving only her name as she hones her mission into a sharp blade.

description: She walked the mountain called Time, calling into the eternal, empty valley, and found an echo of life. 'Kal'tsit, have you found yourself?'
dialog: Test Collection Series/The Remains of Time. An outfit worn by Kal'tsit while in disguise. Countless times, in this manner, she influenced the course of Terra's civilization—ripples in the great river of time, a fleeting mark on her endless journey.

description: Defeating the passage of time is harder than defeating foes on the battlefield.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Ageless Afterglow. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, this tailor-made dress is comfortable, beautiful, and accentuates one's figure. By popular request, it has been made to be a bit sportier than the standard line.

description: The warm sun pierces through the clouds, and what were once the vestiges of frost have now, with the advent of spring, become the first sign of the nurturing land nourishing its children.
dialog: Test Collection Series/After Storm. Frost inevitably gives way to a clear day. Ch'en Hui-chieh patrols the city in her first L.G.D. uniform, re-inspecting the metropolis both familiar and foreign to her.

description: Percussion's suited to those spirits born to be wild, just because when they hit it, you know it'll be with all their strength.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Burst Feline. Stage clothing picked by drummer Blaze herself. There might not be much material, but it's breathable, sweat-absorbent and flame-resistant, ensuring no outfit malfunctions will affect Blaze's performance.

description: Some have noticed a set of suspicious inky footprints on Rhodes Island. They go from the rest area to the control center, leading the curious to see Blaze dragging Amiya along on her pawprint seal playtime.
dialog: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/Explosive Blue Flame. She plays the role of the hero seeking the grimoire said to have been born amidst the Everlasting Flame. Whichever brave soul claims it can break through all rules and bindings.

description: Who ever said that pop singers can't grasp vintage classics from distant lands?
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Melodiosa. Sora's outfit in her time studying and performing at Siracusa's Teatro di Milano. Siracusan musical productions have a unique cultural flair, which in turn calls for accessorizing to match.

description: Wherever you are is a live show.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA361. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: After parting ways with Kroos, Lava prepared several outfits to make it easy for her to traverse the land, and this is one of them.
dialog: 0011 New Release / Dusk Wisteria. Handmade in Lungmen, tailor-fitted with special consideration to exotic design elements. The outfit has been improved in accordance with the customer's preference to incorporate Yan's novel trends.

description: It's not just the clothes that Lava likes. She's even more intrigued to the righteous warriors in Yanese stories who smite evil and restore order. This is presumably the reason why ever since she put on this outfit, she has been hard at work practicing Yanese swordplay.
dialog: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/Purifying Flame. Yanese-style clothes that show off the wearer's blazing spirit. Ebon garments adorned with flame patterns make one's stalwart righteousness all the more eye-catching.

description: As He decided this body was perfect and sublime, so the Seaborn would ascend from Terra, their destination the infinite sea of stars above the skies.
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Sublimation. In the ocean-soaked wreckage of this great Iberian chapel rests He, and His song comes from the efferent throat, to reach the ears of every Seaborn.

description: 'Then soar, soar to my side.'
dialog: Iteration Provident/Red Countess. Skadi the Corrupting Heart's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Confusion and impulse have begat the sole master of the Crimson Plain. With these emotions, she fashions her beloved creations.

description: 'My thanks to you two Tianshi for accompanying me on my journey so far, but it's about time we went our separate ways.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Ten Thousand Mountains. Ch'en Hui-chieh entered the capital on a starry night, and left before sunrise after settling matters. She bid farewell to old friends and took a sampan down the river, the lamp on the prow crashing through the fog and night.

description: Still very much enjoying her holungday. Mind the bubbles. Caution: Wet Floor.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD79. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

description: Nearl has been prepared, since the very outset of her competition participation, to serve as the lighthouse that shines through Kazimierz's night sky. The torrents of time have not sufficed to quench this flame, instead only allowing her to burn brighter.
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Relight. One of the many suits of armor worn by Nearl in her debut competition season, this one a modification of a campaign knight suit.

skinName.en: A Picnic Before A Long Trip

description: 'Where's our next stop, little lamb? The ocean of pink? The erupting volcano? There's still lots of places I'd love to go. Once we're done with this cake, we can head off~'
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Picnic Before A Long Trip. Bam! Everyone's become teeny-tiny, must be another one of Dolly's pranks! Good thing the cream didn't stain her dress, because Eyjafjalla will need it for a dance of azure blue.

description: “爸爸，妈妈，一起坐下吧。这些都是我自己记录下的故事，现在就讲给你们听。”
dialog: EPOQUE系列新款/后来的故事。阿黛尔最喜欢的一套便服。柔软舒适的居家服和绵绒拖鞋所带来的令人安心的触感，能唤起她最珍视的回忆。

description: Atop the stairs, her figure, sword in hand, is as pure and dazzling as the morning light.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection/Glorious Path. Ceremonial clothes worn by Vina Victoria. The natural combination of black and white is contrasted with golden ornamentation, granting the wearer majesty and unbridled charm.

description: The will of the Texas family she should have enforced.
dialog: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Willpower. Classic Siracusan womenswear. By request of Texas, all parts once white have been dyed completely black.

description: Life, is all about doing whatever you want.
dialog: Cambrian 1096 Winter New Arrivals/Winter Messenger. Waterproof with handmade details, it includes special sleeves, detachable parts and zipper pockets.

description: 'You know that every collection has its own fairy tale. That's part of its history.'
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Curator. Scholar's garb straight from a fairy tale. Stuff your magic, knowledge, and curiosity in the pockets, and take notes with Reed.

description: To warm hearts and show the road ahead. Her light now shines for this purpose.
dialog: Reed the Flame Shadow's festive attire/Glowing Flame in the Night. Don a white sweater and thick boots, drape yourself in a red cloak, heft up bundles of presents and brightness, then step into the tranquil night sky.

description: The blazing sun treads the waves, the flame shadow cleanses the heart.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA075. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: After they started playing 'Destiny Quest', Kroos set up an adventurer's guild with her friends called 'Here We Are' and started planning big plans for some large-scale hunting quests. However, looking at guides wasn't a part of those plans.
dialog: Achievement Star Collection/The Apprentice and Her Aura. Clothes Kroos wore when receiving an award at a game expo. She'd just cleared some quests with her friends when she was picked as the lucky player. Wearing the dev-provided costume, she smiled widely at the camera.

description: Green tiles in the morning mist, warm freeze on yellow flowers. Step through the halls, step with the song. —Kroos' first Yanese poem, translated
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Along the Corridor. Made by Lungmen craftsmen from premium Shangshu silk. Elegant and classical patterns with cyan lining make for a dignified outfit.

description: 'Step aside. The silence and blood won't bother me one bit, and I need to get the others back to the ball ASAP.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Born as One. An engraving leaves a shadow, like two sides of a coin, or the cycle of day and night. When both are aware of their dual nature, Laurentina possesses a soul most complete, like unto the twin moons.

description: It's true that Hibiscus is happy to wear such pretty clothes, but what makes her even happier is being afforded the opportunity as both a Sarkaz and an Infected. Their struggles have meant something, she thinks.
dialog: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Romance Overflow. Elaborate dress Hibiscus wore to promote a sightseeing train. Brilliant purples, beautiful hem, and delicate ornamentation—a perfect union of elegance and romance.

description: To get her tail nice and evenly tanned, or to enjoy chopping through waves with her axe? That is the question.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD26. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

description: The mad doctor orders the nurse to start the lab's high-power shock machine! The detective rises once more from the operating table that prophesied his death! Will he be able to escape this deadly experiment? To Be Continued, in the next issue!
dialog: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/Biochemical Submergence. Outfit of the detective who snuck into the Hospital of Horror. Falling into a mysterious liquid, his back laden with a biochemical tank that may serve as key evidence. Can he uncover the terrifying truth?

description: At the 1st-anniversary performance commemorating the premiere of the Rhodes Island-version of The Nutcracker, Greyy takes the stage again amidst the cheers of the crowd, closing the curtains on today's show along with the 'musicians' on stage.
dialog: Greyy festival costume/Aftershow. Finely-crafted costumes and props made by the Operators are very popular amongst the Rhodes Island audience.

description: 虽然已经飞过了数不清的岛屿和山头，但他的探索欲望还远没有被满足。转动一下控制气球的舵轮，夜幕降临之前，再记录一片林地的风景吧。
dialog: 生命之地[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/千尺俯瞰。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description: Yet another Carnevale, and all Texas wants is to relax, but her annoying boss has hidden himself in every balloon, telling her to get back to work. Nothing she can do except step on each and every one of them.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Il Segreto Della Notte. A form-fitting combination of tailored clothes and exquisite accessories, displaying one's status without drawing too much attention. Comes with a VIP Carnevale invitation and too many balloons.

description: 'But Wingbreaker, did you know that behind the seven layers of golden gates remain only shepherds of demons, and nothing more of your old friends?'
dialog: Iteration Provident Series/Wingbreaker. Texas the Omertosa's iteration from decision point F/3019226. The hunter shot down the great demon Vermithrax, but was betrayed by the Lone Wolf Emperor and banished to the barrens.

description: She might have forgotten that she's making a delivery.
dialog: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/City Rider. Designed by Exusiai herself, 'I didn't think too much about the design, actually. I just made something that I'd like to wear.'

description: The night before the Doctor's team arrives at Lungmen, Exusiai and Texas have gathered all the intel needed. Before going back to rest, however, Texas forced her to put on this partner-provided uniform and rehearsed multiple courses of action.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Midnight Delivery. As part of our cooperation agreement, Rhodes Island ordered this operator uniform for Exusiai. She can be seen wearing it, from time to time, during operations in Lungmen.

description: Armed to the teeth.
dialog: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Wild Operation. Made with special materials, it has multiple functions that can meet the needs in all kinds of natural environments.

description: All foresight needs a place to rest, and that habitat is where all living things stand.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Habitat. Silence's dress for public events. She's been busy of late, and drifts to sleep in front of the camera. Luckily, she has Ifrit's handmade alarm clock to help her stay awake.

description: He sees a Laterano: united, efficient, serene. Under absolute rationality, the individual is but a gear in the machine, and he is its core.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Allmind As One. A possibility derived from when Executor connected to the Law: connected consciousnesses tend towards unity, all to achieve one goal. Exsequi. Exsequi. Exsequi.

description: Though often the mysteries of fate and the journey ahead are unknown, his resolve to unveil time's secrets and uncover the truth has never wavered.
dialog: Brand Collaborative Series/The Train Runner. As a child, dressed in pristine clothes, he too chased the shadows of trains out of curiosity. Now, stepping onto exotic platforms, his goals are far clearer.

description: To ensure the music video would go off without a hitch, Swire prepared as much as she could. Her group dances amidst the flickering lights, their voices carrying their song to the sky. She sets aside all titles and pretense, her only hope being that this will be an unforgettable performance.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Rhythmic Blocks. Swire's chic and breezy concert outfit, showcasing all her vivacity and cuteness. She leads the choreography, gladly accepting the applauses and affection from her stans.

description: “古人编纂典籍记录知识，今人承继智慧，我要做的就是贯通融会，古为今用，让龙门再多点新光景！怎么样，不赖吧？”
dialog: 国家图书馆合作服装/盛世之象。诗怀雅在参加文化庆典时穿着的服装。医、技、艺、工，各个展位被她装点得琳琅满目，她将历史穿在身上，盛迎天下贵宾。

description: 'Y-You're threatening me because I'm a new actress?' 'Uhh, Laura, your butt won't hurt any longer.' 'We must learn to get along with these Laterans. We don't have a choice—' 'D-Director Nian, how was that?'
dialog: Collaborative Series/'Ride to Davistown'. Clothes the rookie actress Jessica wore for her audition. Whether pointing a gun at someone else or at herself, she'd immediately tear up. Director Nian was real pleased.

description: 据她本人评价，这是有史以来最诡异的角色设计。
dialog: 成就之星系列/绝对主角。维什戴尔在特别游戏活动中的变格形象。从脾气上能看得出她确实还是那个维什戴尔。

description: 'We're finally here, Doctor. Is this ship floating out in space supposed to be an old haunt of yours? What, feeling anxious? Well too bad, you don't have a choice. 'Wiš'adel', here to destroy your Originium project now that it's running wild.'
dialog: Test Collection Series/Supernova. Clothes Wiš'adel wears when stepping into the unknown of space to corral Originium run wild. According to her, since she's here to clean up the trash, she should wear something suitable for the occasion.

description: This gentle melody, she gives to her fellow teammates, her gathered friends, and to all who hope for a peaceful holiday season.
dialog: Fang the Fire-Sharpened's performance outfit for holiday celebrations/A Pure Pianissimo. The black-and-white performance wear is outlined with neat contours. It is a design Fang is fond of, a symbol of the festive melody she is about to compose.

description: She will satisfy your every whim, free of charge, just like how you are doing your best to please her.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Unruly Humbleness. Bartender and bar-owner Lappland, with some of her colleagues in tow, happily welcomes in tonight's employer and Boss.

description: If all of existence is boundless, then his heart shall be as a boundless sail. Unperturbed by the billowing waves, he sails forward, sword in hand.
dialog: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Boundless Sail. Exercise attire based on a fencer's protective clothes. Offers both comfort and fashion alongside all-day defense.

description: 顺着书上的描述，跨越五方山川，渡去四海之外，煌终于见到了传说中的生物。“你的名字应该是，呃......这个古字怎么念来着？”
dialog: 国家图书馆合作服装/夜行烛火。煌在游历炎国各方异域时所穿的服装。书中山海万象，手中炽焰长明，奇珍瑞兽相伴身侧，她踏焰前行。

description: The Feline woman rushes home. There is someone waiting to cook with her back at their warm, candlelit home, after all. This time, she wants to be around for prepping the dumpling skins.
dialog: Cambrian 1102 Winter New Arrivals/Homecoming Night. Made from multiple layers of multifunctional materials. A light down coat to keep warm, a silver coating to ward off rain and wear. Perfect for both lounging at home and riding a steed of steel.

description: She does not know, nor will anyone know, that years later, the melody she once hummed offhand in a tavern would be passed down as 'the first angel's song.'
dialog: Iteration Provident/The Legend Seeker. Exusiai the New Covenant's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Legend has become a joke on everyone's lips, but the bard in the red cloak has never stopped seeking the truth.

description: 你突然忘记了自己为何来到此地，也想不起在阳光下注视这场表演的初衷。但这就是寻找真我的旅程，不知哪一个他的声音，在不经意间传到了你的耳中。
dialog: 错位巡礼新定义[第零位相/PhaseZero]系列特别款/真我自扼。正午的烈阳之下，橄榄广场的羽兽鸣啭中，上演着让围观者通晓哲理的夺目艺术。

description: If you wish to uncover the secrets of the ancients, if you wish to obtain power sealed away, you must be of tremendous courage and inordinate resilience. In this inescapable, ultimate trial, she shall be your opponent.
dialog: Achievement Star Collection/The Bloodwing Rose. Leizi's character in 'Dark Age of Terra'. Amidst bloodwing's roar, twisting, thorned peals of thunder descend. Of all the challenges the adventurers have faced, she is the prickliest by far.

description: 想来一次街头飙车追捕，还是一场公园武艺死斗？挑战由你来选，但是否留情由她来决定。
dialog: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/一闪极意。为能在街头一扫邪气的凛然之人所设计的服饰。镇邪符纸在蓝焰的光芒下更加显眼，映照出她快意无畏的鬼族英姿。

description: 为困于阴霾与风雪中无法前进的人们，带来抚慰心灵的颂歌，和光明再临的宣告。
dialog: 音律联觉特供款/曙光祝颂。笼罩在时光之上的层层阴云已然破开，装饰着晨星的披风内衬象征着得到净化的天际，而她佩戴的头饰绽放出了灿然的曙光。

description: Swing once, send five fowlbeasts scampering. Swing twice, make a blue fowl land on the fingertip. Swing three times, make the teacher's pet hysterical again.
dialog: Brand Collaborative Series/Rainforest, Me, Rainbow. The waterproof, breathable fabric comes in handy for rainforest work. Lightweight, wear-resistant, and protects from the sun. Tail attachment optional.

description: Beauty is also important in battles.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Spring Vouivre. Handmade by Lungmen craftsman, this stylish outfit combines comfortable materials with cutting-edge tech and traditional handicraft. Custom-made services are also available.

description: An arc and thunder, dividing ally from enemy.
dialog: Striker Series/Overload. A product of Raythean Industries, a combat outfit fully tailored to exceptional specialist personnel. Offers reliable defense in all environments, further supports the Operator's own Originium Arts.

description: She spends more time in her work attire than normal.
dialog: Pioneer Series/Lacquer. Raythean Industrial's new product is fully sealed and made with special fabrics that are resistant to even the harshest environmental conditions. Its dust-proof design is suitable for researchers who enter and exit dangerous areas.

description: Cold cannot hinder the thirst for knowledge.
dialog: Cambrian 1097 Winter New Arrivals/Frosted Breath. Layered insulating design, free to be mixed and matched to individual taste. Catered to the client's personal needs, this fit has been altered by hand, adjusting the left sleeve's opening and adding an arm guard.

description: Set the crystal ball aside - traveling is all about looking forward to the unknown.
dialog: EPOQUE New Arrivals/Unknown Journey. Trendy, made for the spring season, well-fitting and comfortable, comes with a choice of accessories that can be mixed and matched to suit your style.

description: Deepcolor describes epic scenes while fiddling with the strange terminal. Gradually, you begin to see visions of a silhouette fighting strange foes. You do not know if this came from reality, or fiction.
dialog: Cambrian 1099 New Winter Collection/Melodic Portrayal. Stylishly loose-fitting, comfortable and mobile. The waterproof surface keeps it from being stained by paint, making it the ideal outfit for artists.

description: She will forever stand before her followers, and she will lead them forward, back to their homeland.
dialog: Striker Series/City Destroyer. A product of Raythean Industries, this defensive gear is designed for robust combat, with additional high-density shock-absorbent elements present in the lining that answer the impact of attacks, while simultaneously tailored in parts to ensure high flexibility.

description: Already used to the strange life.
dialog: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Legacy. Made with special materials and designed to be functional, perfect for coping with various needs and weathering even the roughest outdoor conditions.

description: After hearing of Theresa's past deeds, for just a moment, W was truly lost thinking about it: 'Are there really people who'd go and put childlike ideals like that into practice?'
dialog: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Fugue. Ordinary Sarkaz mercenary wear. Easy to mend, protective, and carries even more explosives after simple modification.

description: The Ursus people never hide their leading views on fashion trends.
dialog: I.T Brand UNDER GARDEN Collab Outfit/Ursus IO79. A black and red base. A compact design, drawing from casual accessories to give a boost to color variety, bringing about a brand new fashion experience.

description: The right temperament and clothing converge in just the perfect manner.
dialog: MARTHE New Arrivals/Ready to Go. Inspired by traditional Ursus school uniforms, this season's most successful iteration is fine-tuned to capture the trends of today's youth. Top seller in Ursus.

description: Hard work always pays off.
dialog: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Bitter Herbs. Made with special materials, it has multiple functions that can meet the needs in all kinds of natural environments.

description: 'Execute without pardon.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Wind of Breaking Blade. Shirayuki's combat attire in her confrontation with Samuraitaisho serving the North, during the Northern and Southern Courts Battle of Echigo. The head orders: sight enemy, see blood.

description: To give the most beautiful smile to the last sleepless night of the year.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Night Watcher. Handmade by Lungmen craftsman, this stylish outfit combines comfortable materials with cutting-edge tech and traditional handicraft. Custom-made services are also available. Fireproof.

description: May you always look toward the bright future as these flowers do.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Bunch of Sunlight. Outfit specially designed for going out. It uses the operator's main color as basic tone and matches it with a different-colored jacket for a vivid contrast.

description: 'I... knew you'd be here. Sorry, but I won't let you pass. No matter what.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Dreadnaught. The attire worn by the elite operator, Beagle, when serving as rearguard during the Great March of Bolívar. This is her final test.

description: I wish I could spend every day in peace.
dialog: Cambrian 1096 Winter New Arrivals/Cruciata. Waterproof with handmade details, it includes special sleeves, detachable parts and zipper pockets.

description: Kroos falls into a long, long dream. In that dream, she dons star and moon, and sails the ocean blue. She meets a few interesting people, and sees plenty of comedy and tragedy both. Where will her journey take her next? She's eager to find out.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Moonlit Voyage. Themed around the night sky, the moon and oceanic voyages, the dream-like weave of star and sea feels like going on a fantastical journey, with drifting moon and stars as companions.

description: The holiday's true value lies in this smile.
dialog: Witch Feast Series/the mag. An outfit that Kroos designed for herself. In addition to being fashionable, it incorporates some mechanisms to assist her with her magic tricks.

description: The bowstring trembles, the chord sounds, the wind leaves behind stories in its wake.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bard's Holiday. Trendy autumn attire, loose and breathable. Incorporates a unique multi-layer pocket design, convenient for holding all sorts of lightweight souvenirs during a serendipitous sojourn.

description: Gwiazdcytron trees can only grow in Kazimierz. In the times they still remember, the forest wardens are warm and safe, just like their hometown.
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Gwiazdcytrony. Meteor's winter clothes from back in Kazimierz. Balancing lightness and warmth, they also allow one to easily hide in dense forests. A reproduction.

description: Tonight, she will write her own tale—the tale of a princess who conquered the endless wilds, and how she conquered her heart beyond reach.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection/La Valse Couronnée de Fleurs. Formalwear Estelle prepared for a ball. A classic white dress is paired with a sash belt adorned with a ribbon with dangling tails. The picture of grace, yet replete with the elegance of night.

description: Sensitivity that rationality cannot overcome.
dialog: EPOQUE New Arrivals/Serenity. Casual clothing centered around black and purple as main colors to exude a bit of elegance while still maintaining a calm feel. A favorite among women in the workplace, this outfit was Ptilopsis's first choice when going out.

description: Crescents of jade shine upon the peaks, as white owls soar amidst the pale clouds.
dialog: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Among the Clouds. Garments crafted by Baizao's master tailors, embodying Yan's charms as envisioned by the wearer. Ptilopsis lightly plucks the strings, and heaven and earth resound with a crisp melody.

description: 'Why have you come to Elysia, traveler? Do you seek a song, or perhaps an antidote for your beloved?'
dialog: Iteration Provident/Nocturne of Elysia. Blue Poison's iteration from decision point F/3019226. In the land of Elysia, she is the only fairy who is willing to offer a song to the toxic trees.

description: It means a lot to Blue Poison, just because every punch landed feeds back.
dialog: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Shoal Beat. Fitness attire aimed first and foremost at the masses, absorbent and breathable, with strong stretchability. Preorder with full payment to immediately be gifted a random suitcase in a matching color.

description: Patrols weren't obligated, but Dobermann still rounded the block a few times each day, up until this place was torn to ruins by the war.
dialog: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Lieutenant. Clothing modified from Bolívarian military uniform, with some accessories coming from Dobermann's own collection.

description: Better setting out than knives out, on a bright, sunny day like this.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HDm04. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

description: He himself was not as brash as his outfit, and he took out his sword only to take photos. But even with only a single blade, when it came time to help others, he did not doubt himself for a second.
dialog: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/One Blade. Form-fitting, cool, and breathable sportswear, for those patrolling the streets. In a fistfight, the flowing scarlet sleeves become a raging flame. The accompanying sword is most certainly not a prop.

description: May's detective senses tell her that so long as she follows this alley filled with exotic homes, sun and surf will be within reach. Or at the very least, she'll be closer than where she was just now.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA054. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: It'd be best not to let her into the kitchen.
dialog: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Children's Party. Designed by Silence. Made with special materials from Rhine Lab, it offers a completely unnecessary amount of protection.

description: According to Ifrit, 'There ain't a single problem I can't crush.' Even if it's a string of numbers that makes no sense, or a totally boring travel plan—'The only difficulty setting is 'Easy'? I could clear it easily even on the highest one!'
dialog: Brand Collaborative Series/Relaxing Trip. Mark monsters, fortresses, and treasures on the map. Bring along your beloved dolls, a warm drink, and a cheerful mood. Come on, this is what it means to start a trip.

description: It's burnt!
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Sunburn Series Swimming Suit Type SP. Special Rhine Lab Collaboration Type. To meet Rhine Lab's specifications, this outfit is both comfortable and possesses heat-resistant properties.

description: The faint light of the stars is unable to penetrate the depths of the darkness, but she firmly believes that the light she's after will be enough to illuminate every nook and cranny of this land.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Her Aspiration. The clothes Astgenne wore in her rented home. A lab coat thrown over an elegant and close fit, for she must always be ready for a whimsical stroke of inspiration for her experiments.

description: The nightmare that haunts all gangs alike in Lungmen, large or small.
dialog: 0011 Tempest-Series New Arrival/Patrolling Ronin. Several designers joined forces to create a look inspired by the style of the streets. Complete with the redesigned shield of an L.G.D. Officer joined with traditional elements from Higashi, this outfit brings a truly formidable look.

description: If they knew that Hoshiguma crushed the coconut she'd finished drinking with her bare hands before throwing it in the trash, would the waves washing onto the artificial beach become quieter?
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Seeker Series Swimming Suit SK97. The material is light, breathable and exquisite. It's been tailored to meet the needs of those go-getter explorers.

description: These fresh, luscious berries are already driving people crazy. What if you dipped them in a touch of thick honey... Wait, did you see that Ursus girl just now?
dialog: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Honey Pilferer. Beehunter's sleepwear. Fluffy, soft, comfortable, tight-fitting, and easy to wash, this outfit is suitable for both home use and as sleepwear. What nobody expected is that Beehunter would head straight to the food festival.

description: 'Is that all? That's all our lives are worth. I told you, everything you've taken from me, I'll have you repay. In full.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Refined Horrormare. The outfit Lappland wore at the Laterano Apostolic Knights' Funeral Memorial Hall. Collect the debts, and pay the price.

description: Disappearances, odd deaths, clues that lead into the unknown. In the Dark Forest, by the light of the blood-red moon, the detective hears the name of the 'Hospital of Horror' for the very first time, straight from the smiling therapist's lips.
dialog: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/The Nursing Home Creepshow. Outfit of the Dark Forest's therapist in the story. Holding poison in her right hand, her fingertips curled towards her subtle smile, making others wonder if those heavy chains are of any use.

description: She cares a lot about this outfit, even though she already can't remember why.
dialog: Cambrian 1096 Winter New Arrivals/Undercurrent. Waterproof with handmade details, it includes special sleeves, detachable parts and zipper pockets.

description: Hunting aquatic prey calls for new equipment, and Red's trialing it right now.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Light Breeze Series Launch Type LB01. A swimsuit and jacket set designed with the full body in mind. Sure to satisfy your waterside athletic needs.

description: You can always meet new friends at the beach.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD08. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

description: Treading through myriad wildernesses, all to track down a past vision recalled.
dialog: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Wasteland Walker. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made with special materials suited for adapting to all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.

description: Not even the dark night can conceal her glow.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Silent Night Series Swimming Suit Type 02. The material is light, soft, breathable and durable. The latest design that is as enchanting as it is elegant.

description: Even the Radiant Knight must still apply sunblock and set up parasols beneath the seaside sun.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SD01. Tight-fitting, breathable, lightweight, and designed for the summer.

description: Even if the land is dead and dry, Scavenger will still survive.
dialog: Striker Series/Survive. A product of Raythean Industries, adopting the latest in adaptive clothing material, paired with an all-encompassing tailoring that tightly hugs the skin, ensuring operators' survival under the most extreme circumstances.

description: You may forget where you came from, but not where you are going to.
dialog: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Quadrangle. Made with special materials, it has multiple functions that can meet the needs in all kinds of natural environments.

description: 'Wow! The flowers in the water are so pretty, and the goldfins are too! If I take some back, every day will be as bright as summer! ...Err, what did I come here to get again?'
dialog: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Amongst Lotuses. Summer clothes inspired by lotus flowers, made for Cuora by Yanese artisans. Only after countless back-and-forths with the client did the backpack's design finally receive her approval.

description: 'This is the end you deserve for forcing the people to live in hatred and unease. Now fall. Hand your filthy soul over to the city pavement.'
dialog: Iteration Provident Series/The Dark Night Terminator. Crownslayer's iteration from decision point S/5258902. Dark clothes for an assassin. She grips her blade, determined to bring an end to the darkest corners of the city with her own hands.

description: 'The celebration is about to begin~ Sound the horns, spread the confetti, and follow me!'
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Light Gold Celebration. Generalissimo Myrtle's attire during her triumphant return. Stand at attention–– and salute!

description: The great generalissimo has defeated the sun. Enjoy the triumph of the sea breeze before moving on to conquer the waves.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA062. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: That was the 10-star 'Clapolpolska' randomed from the song category! So? Did my skills amaze you?' Myrtle points at the screen, showing off her perfect full combo result to you.
dialog: Taiko no Tatsujin Collaboration Outfit/Bustling Festival. Myrtle no longer cares about scoremaxxing during this grand festival, having fun drumming to the beat, rousing the audience's spirit. Don Don—KA!

description: 'Aside from memoirs, I do occasionally write fiction. Here, have a peek—Oh, don't mind the wine stains, but the characters' deeds feel mighty familiar, don't they? Doesn't matter what I write—my pen hand keeps going back to the old gang. It's a real headache, I tell you!'
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Behind the Words. Morgan's outfit for when she's drafting her next work. A classic windbreaker makes an odd pairing for form-fitting innerwear, a bold statement showing that a serious attitude and a rebellious personality don't have to clash.

description: Civilization asks that people dress appropriately, but oftentimes, it takes the good old rules of nature to settle an incident.
dialog: Striker Series/Valiant General. A product of Raythean Industries, this traditional Victorian formal attire has been reworked with upgraded materials across the board, alongside a lining imbued with the latest in structured textiles, providing effective protection against sharp instruments.

description: With warmth still her companion, she is not alone.
dialog: Firewatch's Winter Clothing/Snowywatch. An outfit made for the priority demands of rural activity and cold resistance, with hues adhering to nature, simple and soft, aimed towards hunters and Messengers operating long-term in the northern wilds.

description: When the cypress withers away, what remains is a new lease of life.
dialog: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Wilted Cypress. Made with special materials and designed to be functional, perfect for coping with various needs and weathering even the roughest outdoor conditions.

description: Ah, games—a whole new domain ripe for conviction.
dialog: Achievement Star Collection/Your Superconvicting Friend. A complimentary outfit that came with the luxury limited edition of a retro arcade machine. Loose and relaxed with a classic palette, this fit will both flaunt your gamer status and accompany you on your daily outings.

description: 'This is the treasury of Lachedamon, and my workshop. You want weapons that can kill Them? Give me some time.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Ignis. The hammering of iron resounds across the mountains. The weapons she forges are known as Ignis, for the power contained within them is enough to set all of Terra ablaze.

description: The time has suddenly come, reversing black and white.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Light and Shadow. A trendy, vintage Victorian appeal, modified to Nightmare's specifications. Some decorative elements will change when Nightmare's personality shifts.

description: 'My dear, how can the land of love be real when these lands are so full of hardship? Love and loss walk hand in hand. Do you understand now? This ferry is the final stop. Alright then, now close your eyes, and sleep tight.'
dialog: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/The Ferry Girl. Clothes Gloria wears on outings. The pink and white of the dress and the flowers complement each other. This is the ferry to the land of love, and she's waiting for you to board.

description: Keep the swimming suit from fire.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Temperature Difference Series Swimming Suit Type RX01. Attached with various accessories for convenient use. The special material is fire and cold-proof and suitable for activities in a variety of waters.

description: She's just taking the chance to suntan while on call as an emergency medic—is that an explanation you'd believe?
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD31. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

description: This is her home.
dialog: Witch Feast Series/the feast. A custom-made outfit for Warfarin that incorporates holiday designs with Sarkaz motifs. The designer personally embellished this outfit with plenty of jewelry.

description: Enciodes rejected those insignificant, sycophantic invitations to cooperation. He believes Kjerag will eventually conquer the entire audience, but understands that now is not the time for the ice to melt.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Never-melting Ice. One of SilverAsh's suits, tailored for important events. The weight of the name of Silverash clan can tear rifts across Terra. Even majestic glaciers and roiling clouds make way for him.

description: One glance, and you already know everything you need about Victoria's sacred tome.
dialog: SilverAsh's Tailor-Made Outfit by Savile/York's Bise. The expensive fabrics are as cold-resistant as possible while still ensuring comfort. Combined with a special scarf to reflect the discerning taste of the tailor.

description: Though the Silverashes will never be afraid of challenges, summertime seaside still feels a bit too hot.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Seeker Series Swimming Suit SKm01. The material is light, breathable and exquisite. It's been tailored to meet the needs of those inventive elites.

description: Be careful whenever you take a step, and cherish it whenever you reach the top.
dialog: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Lone Climber. Made with special materials, it has multiple functions that can meet the needs in all kinds of natural environments.

description: Explore, witness, protect.
dialog: WWF Collaborative Series/Highlands Visitor. Using synthetic materials to capture the inspiration of the great outdoors, this outfit is capable of adapting to adverse environments and protects experienced explorers as they visit every corner of Terra.

description: There is no Pramanix here, only an ordinary girl named Enya.
dialog: Pramanix's Tailor-Made Outfit by Savile/Caster's Frost. A full set of hand-made clothing that perfectly fits the wearer's body shape, with additional details to her lifestyle.

description: Bathed in the brilliant flows, Liz sees some beautiful possibilities—but it all comes to an end once she wakes.
dialog: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Iakhu of Flows. In a naptime dream adorned with gold, the earth swells beneath Liz's feet, supporting a homeland. The sphere of the heavens turns above her head, spilling its golden rays upon her.

description: An ancient elegy from the twilight.
dialog: Witch Feast Series/an elegy. An outfit tailored for Nightingale. Who is the one who sings, and what language is it in? Whose dream do I see, and whose death do I see?

description: Tonight, let all the complex investigation reports and lengthy monitoring records stay far away from her. Let her embrace her childlike nature and roam among the bright lights with her cute fluffy friends. This is the gift she deserves.
dialog: Brand Collaborative Series/Fluffy Little Witch. Perhaps every girl has dreamed of it—raising a parasol, donning a top hat, letting her magic dance across the night sky. She tells her fluffy friends the moment for dreams to come true is here.

description: There's no clash at all between studying volcanoes and a love of playing in the water.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA018. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: She's emitting the fragrance of countless flowers.
dialog: Test Collection/Species Plantarum. Available only in certain regions, this remake of a classic design utilizes the best materials carefully hand-sewn details. An extra custom-made multifunctional tool bag is included.

description: In this age, taking tea and reading until you're tired might just be a style of relaxation to make people envious.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Leisurely Afternoon. Home leisure style, relaxed and pleasing to the eye, graceful and cozy. Comes with a pair of adorable fitted slippers, for an afternoon completely free of cares wherever you are.

description: Field surveys are not vacations. As long as she has her stick, her notebook and her sample box, it counts as work.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Major Field. Practical yet dignified, it protects from the elements on field surveys, but can also be worn under a jacket for conferences.

description: Just rehydrate between sets! Once you're all done, there are some cookies on the table as a reward!
dialog: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Hydration Time. Clothes specially designed for gym-heads, made from light and breathable materials. Enjoy unprecedented comfort and lightness during your training.

description: Where are you? Are you doing well? Can we picnic together again?
dialog: Vitafield [Camper] Series Classics/Campfire Cooking Smoke. Warm fur coat paired with red woven scarf for an inviting sight.

description: Don't forget your purpose even in the heat of battle.
dialog: EPOQUE First Edition/Combat Medic. Based upon a special-issue Ádakrys battlesuit, it has blades attached in the right parts to give off an extremely aggressive look. Gavial describes it as her ideal 'battlefield trappings.'

description: 'I like leading the vanguard in all my battles. In his case, I imagine it'd be the shieldguard.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Octopath Illusion. Hellagur's clothing during his time as vanguard commander in the Bloodpeak Campaign. If he weren't an enemy, if he could have served Ursus... Even if no such possibility existed.

description: Vermeil doesn't only hunt in the Siracusan wilds. Sometimes, toy shops are her hunting grounds. Let's see what she caught this time!
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Playfellows. Comfy casual clothes Vermeil changed into, sharing the dolls she collected with everyone at the party. Who would've thought she had such a cute collection?

description: No longer needing to carry a heavy burden, no longer having to stay at arms, she can now easily face a new challenge in life.
dialog: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Easy Time. A popular design with fitness lovers in mind. Stitchless weaving techniques and high-performance elastic materials come together for a smooth feel, ensuring snugness and flexibility during exercise.

description: 'People are still sending children onto the battlefield? Got it, I'll handle this rescue mission.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Breaking the Ice. Operator Frostleaf's attire during her special appointment by the Rhodes Island Columbia branch to conduct a search and rescue in the nation's north. Life has bestowed her the resolve to return to the battlefield.

description: 离开这里，明天是否又要面对无法逃避的苦涩？“只要记得歌谣唱起的方法，任何消沉都不过是一时云烟”，她拨响琴弦，用歌声对你的问题做出了回答。
dialog: 错位巡礼新定义[第零位相/PhaseZero]系列特别款/来日欢歌。回廊的雕饰之间，升起的夜幕之下，流转着让来访者不思归去的欢乐曲调。

description: The most fun in life is had in books and through food.
dialog: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Bibliosmia. After being re-coordinated to reflect the national outfits of the people of Ursus, Istina wore this outfit to promote traditional cuisine at the food festival. Underneath the plain materials are countless intricate details, and only those who deem themselves wise come to seek answers.

description: No free jacket or ice cream cart included.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA011. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: Count Rostov sees his eldest daughter as his magnum opus. But after an unexpected encounter with adversity, Natalya chooses to be herself.
dialog: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Masterpiece. The outfit worn by Natalya Andreyevna Rostova, student council president of Chernobog #4 Secondary School, during her commencement speech.

description: Natalya still knows exactly what makes an afternoon tea perfect—the colors, the frosting, the tea at just the right warmth. But right now? That doesn't matter at all. 'Phew… I'll just lie here for a bit. Just a little bit, that's all.'
dialog: Brand Collaborative Series/Forever Together. Black tea, lemon, colorful little sweets, and lots of soft, friendly companions. Forget stiff manners and anything that ties you down, and just lie back. Your friends' warm, welcoming arms are always there to embrace you.

description: They say you can see another side to someone when they perform an instrument, but performing an instrument is itself an act too.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Speechless Sound. Stage clothing picked by bassist Courier himself. People think of Kjerag's men as steadfast and untalkative, but Courier's ready with his bass to change their perception.

description: A carefree journey starts from taking the next step.
dialog: Cambrian 1096 Winter New Arrivals/New Routes. Waterproof with handmade details, it includes special sleeves, detachable parts and zipper pockets.

description: Thanks to his effort, the beach is safer.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Beach Guard Series Swimming Suit Launch Type 001. Made with materials that are both durable and comfortable, this outfit ensures high performance in a variety of different conditions.

description: Croissants are obviously delicious!
dialog: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Seven in the Morning. Designed by Croissant. Actually just recycled Exusiai's design because it's cheaper to do it that way.

description: Croissant has prepared a lot for the field trip. She'll surely make a fortune out of it!
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Seeker Series Swimming Suit SK03. The material is light, breathable and exquisite. It's been tailored to meet the needs of those go-getter explorers.

description: When the sunlight scatters the chill air, the warm breeze thaws the clammy clouds, and even the storm has decided to stop over sea—please, allow her some time to rest.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Temperature Difference Series Swimming Suit Type RX07. Attached with various accessories for convenient use. The special material is fire and cold-proof, suitable for activities in a variety of waters.

description: A lone hunter of the wilderness who maintains order for Sami. Her greatest challenge yet: how to explain proper precautions to an enormous combined Scientific Exploration team of nearly a hundred people.
dialog: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Northern Pathfinder. Made with special materials with function in mind, perfect for meeting your various needs and weathering even the roughest conditions.

description: She's been playing all day long and if no one comes to stop her, she'll keep playing.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA333. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: Vulcan took out one piece of clothing after another from the bag, and Ceobe put them on one by one, but she ran away before Vulcan could take out the pants.
dialog: 0011 Tempest Series New Release/Unfettered. A set of children's clothes, Columbian in origin. Vulcan's reward to Ceobe for being a good girl.

description: Apparently Director Nian had a burst of inspiration. Not only has she come up with over a hundred designs for the doomsday kaiju, she is also filming a police-themed action flick with Chongyue as the lead, and shooting another movie just to help Jessica's self-esteem.
dialog: Collaborative Series/Thunderbolt Director. Clothes the prodigy director Nian wears on the job. Having analyzed countless classics, she channels the inspiration into her latest blockbuster: Unlimited Showdown in the Siege of Monster Doomsday.

description: It bugged her how these clothes didn't fit well, so she picked a few places to make a couple of tweaks herself.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Unfettered Freedom. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, per the client's requests, twenty-four different designs of traditional women's clothing were drawn up, from which the client rolled dice to select one to ultimately be made into an outfit.

description: Jade ruminates quietly, while ink keeps its silence. The spring breeze whistles through the carved stone fence, while youth springs forth from the tip of her brush.
dialog: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Hazy Jade. The painter of a thousand forms, wrapped in jade silk. The soul who sculpts ink into shape, entwined in kohl silk. The gauze stretches out before her, serving as her infinite canvas.

description: The distant mountains are as ink, each step leaving smoke. Falling ink becomes art, plain colors reflect the self.
dialog: 0011 New Release / Everything Is a Miracle. A silky and delicate satin surface, perfectly fitted to the wearer's body shape. Blue-green envelops the body, invoking an ancient charm. After completing the outfit's design, the client draws it into existence, ready-to-wear, with a stroke of the brush.

description: Many view the unknown as a darkness to be feared, so they cry out for those who dare stand against and dispel it. That is why they call her name.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Unstained, Unshaken. Outlined in sharp lines and painted in cold tones, revealing the wearer's pioneering, problem-smashing fearlessness in full color.

description: 'What's the matter, Boss? You don't seem as sharp as before. Since you didn't manage to finish me off, I suppose it's my turn now. Don't blink.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Stronghold. An outfit worn by Saria during the confrontation between the General Jurisdiction and the Research Branch. Though her surroundings crumbled under the onslaught of Arts colliding, her conviction never wavered, like the land itself.

description: Submission is order. Order is justice.
dialog: Test Collection Series/The Law. The jailer garments Saria used when entering Mansfield State Prison, largely in line with the female jailer's standard uniform.

description: 'How many starry nights must the long wind blow, and how many springs and autumns must the snowmelt wash, before the wonders of blooming gravel are revealed?'
dialog: Brand Collaborative Series/Towering is Cliff of Nostalgia. Stylish and classic. The wind brushes the cliffs for a thousand years, a thousand li, brushing against the wanderer's robes, brushing into dream.

description: A thousand years of wandering passed in a flash. All truths, all lies, all but a dream. Outside my tent, the wind howls as it ever has. My lord awakens, so I too awake.
dialog: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/A Gallant Dream. Bestial pattern on robe of white, silver plate on black of gown, adorned with jade, an ensemble unfettered. The gongs of the border's night watch ring out, while Ling seeks the great Dao in woven dream.

description: 'Who am I?' 'What am I?' 'Where do I go?' 'Thunder with no rain, bones to dust. The dreamer must wake, the calm be disturbed. Why ask?'
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/It Does Wash the Strings. Robe made from white cloth, with loose-fitting sleeves that reach to knee level. A lucky animal is weaved onto the skirt, inspired by a dream the client had.

description: Having suddenly gone from stunt coordinator to leading man, Chongyue admits he's not too sure what to do right now, especially after seeing one younger sister sitting in the director's chair, and another on the set drinking from her flask.
dialog: Collaborative Series/All-Round Actor. Clothes Chongyue wears when studying past roles. The characters are so different, so how should one breathe life into them? He browses both scripts and tapes, experiencing life after life after life.

description: O lush wood, how long have you stood? O fluttering pale plumes, how far have you wandered? The seasons turn, and the white feathers return not. O barren tree, where could they perch?
dialog: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Alighting. Magnum opus of a Yumen craftsman, given to a traveler heading on a long journey. In the hope that men and might need no longer be a burden, that he can wander for myriad li with ease.

description: She was always the first to arrive. She always tidied everything up in silence. She was always the last to leave.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Spring Feast. Outfit Shu wore during a feast held by her family. A beauteous purple robe across her shoulders, a silken skirt along her legs. Here, a goddess lies, quietly watching the turning of the seasons.

description: “春雨少，用水浇；夏雨多，开渠道。”黍还记得很久以前她和人们一同将这则农谚记录在书卷上的情景。如今，当年的纸张已经泛黄，而她脚下稻谷青青，浓绿一片。
dialog: 国家图书馆合作服装/源远流长。黍在天师府工作时穿着的服装。古卷在她的面前展开，代代相传的智慧浮现纸上，一如脚下长河奔流不息，一径向前。

description: You need to get to the market as early as possible to pick the best ingredients. Though what he sees in the early morn are things he has seen a hundred times before, he can almost already hear his brothers and sisters rejoicing in their reunion.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Clear Morning View. Clothes Yu wears when getting ingredients for the reunion dinner. The gold-embroidered top under his cyan jacket billows in the wind. Amidst verdant green, the young man begins his return to his dream of a family gathering.

description: Silk flows with the water, and the Kuranta walks with the wind.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SD05. Tight-fitting, breathable, lightweight, and designed for the summer.

description: 'Terra will be witness to Kjerag's precipitous rise.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Forerunner. Following the Vine-Bead Court's final meeting of the Tri-Clan Council, Gnosis formally assumed the post of inaugural Speaker of the Parliament of Kjerag by SilverAsh's recommendation.

description: A blast from the middle school past.
dialog: A uniform from Victoria's Wessex Middle School, adapted by traditional Victorian designers. Centuries of rich heritage combines with excellent craftsmanship to make a light and comfortable outfit.

description: As she jumps out the window and faces the sun, she can't help but believe that her future will be as bright as it is today.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sunny Day. Cardigan's outfit when she had just arrived at a city in southern Leithanien. Skillfully tailored to fit a young girl's stature. Light, airy, and blooming with vitality.

description: When happiness blocks the door.
dialog: Cardigan's Winter Wear/Cheerful Guardian. Lightweight, comfortable, full of wintry motifs, but not cold-resistant at all. Cardigan is a bit afraid of the cold, but in front of a bag of gifts and her favorite sled, the temperature stops seeming so important.

description: Prior to his reunion with his teammates, Steward mingled with businesspeople of all nations, carefully weighing the benefits each of them could bring Kjerag.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Snowstorm Invitation. An outfit tailor-made by Karlan Trade for their affiliated business negotiators. First impressions are of the utmost importance in trade talks. Steward knows this well, and has never failed to live up to expectations.

description: Before reuniting with his teammates, he took up the duties of a Legatus, traveling among the nations of Terra.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Traceless Walker. Custom-made by the Lateran Curia for certain Legati. Sankta who get custom outfits all share a common feature: there is something unusual about their halos.

description: 'If nocturnality is a racial trait, couldn't you at least provide coffee at night for other Cautus operators? No? But you drink it every night!'
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Nighttime Café. Always meticulous, Ansel likes to be properly dressed at the café as well. He steadfastly refuses to sell coffee at night, however.

description: Where should I set my next beach stronghold?
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HDm06 for men. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation. Critically acclaimed outfit for men, on sale now.

description: 'Close your eyes. Imagine you have arrived at the end of time. There is nobody there. Only the sun, the moons, and the instruments. Then, you hear music, and you cannot help but open your eyes. Welcome to the concert, just for you.'
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Ethereal Harmony. Stage clothing picked by conductor Mostima herself. A mysterious blue serves as the main hue, a blue of grace and beauty, a fitting accompaniment to the stage she built.

description: Beneath the gaze of justice, evil tumbles into the abyss.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Spellbreaker. A Laterano dress with corresponding weapons. Generally, only Sankta who have presided over the ceremonies are allowed to wear it, and Mostima seems to have quietly snuck out with this outfit.

description: 'My little friends, you're in charge of setting up the background tonight. For each paper cutout placed crooked, I'm taking one piece of candy out of your present!'
dialog: Kafka's holiday work attire / Cardboard Fairy. A smorgasbord of different elements and styles, featuring a red undergarment that contrasts with the green jacket. Kafka's fashion sense is as bold as her découpage.

description: The stinger of Sargon reflects no moonlight. Wrapped in darkness, she only shows herself only when the outcome is no longer in doubt.
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Under A Veil. Manticore once wore it on a mission in Sargon, and was bothered by the clanging of the gold accessories as she moved.

description: With a light touch of her tail, courage, fear, and shyness become things of the past, along with life itself.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Invisible Dirge. Taking the model's peculiar traits in consideration, this outfit was completed without being tailored. Combines comfort, fashion, and a proper fit while also protecting the operator's vitals.

description: Mercenaries roam the city, their backs to the night and the people they wish to protect.
dialog: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Silent Arrow. An Iberian classic, enhanced with the customer's own artistic touches. Andreana particularly appreciates this outfit's moisture resistance.

description: 这是她第一次放松警惕如此悠闲吗？看看星月下凉风中她露出的笑容，答案就不言自明了。
dialog: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣240款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description: She blends in with the rubble and the smoke.
dialog: Pioneer Series/Graphite. Raythean Industrial's new product line is based upon standard-issue battlesuits, utilizing new materials and a weatherproof design suitable for harsh environments.

description: The happy days will pass away, but the memories will firmly remain within your mind, accompanying you through all kinds of dangers.
dialog: EPOQUE New Series/Miraculous Moment. Casual clothes that capture the region's impressions while taking the customer's preferences in consideration. After a deep dive into the customer's life, the designer collaborated with the customer to add a variety of supporting accessories.

description: The young lady always seems to be staring off in a daze these days. Not because she's surrounded by unfamiliar people, but rather she's secretly worried that she put on her uniform in the wrong order.
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Royal Guardswoman. Bagpipe's uniform as a new cadet at the military academy, doubling as formal wear. Training in formal wear was yet another duty of a royal guardsman cadet.

description: The life Bagpipe dreams of is simple. After a productive day of farmwork, she picks up the satisfaction of a hard day's work and her hopes for a bumper crop before walking home under the setting sun, accompanied by the distant sound of bagpipes. It will come true. She believes it with all her heart.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Echo of Bagpipes. Clothes Bagpipe wears when she heads home. No need for any fancy accessories. A simple dress and a bright smile are enough to charm even the critters frolicking by her side.

description: But the racers were scared of Bagpipe, because on the off-chance of a crash, they'd be the only ones injured. Luckily, that was another reason the organizers asked her to be the flag-bearer.
dialog: Whistlewind Series Race Queen Core Line/Queen, No.1. In full race queen form, sporting a Raythean-sponsored Piledriver Spear, Bagpipe carries herself tall and brings the spectators' cheers non-stop.

description: Medicine's a useful tool. How do you wanna use it?
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Doctor of Faces. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, with a design concept more inclined towards the East, its main appeal is to highlight the wearer's personality. Onlookers can sense the simplicities and trends of Lungmen.

description: Practicing medicine is like spraying pesticide. It can uproot disease, or it can snuff out life. Life or death begins with the formula, ends with the dosage, and depends entirely on intent.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Healing Hand, Evil Heart. Handmade in Lungmen, the outfit includes multiple pieces of clothing that can be mixed and matched based on the customer's mood. The details in the outfit have been adjusted according to his needs, and includes an old-fashioned medicine box.

description: 'Ordinary' is a unique kind of quality. When the time comes calling, do abandon it.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Just A Driver. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, with a design concept more inclined towards the West, its main appeal being to create a balanced sense of uniform. Many fasteners adorn the outfit, reserving space for the client to personalize, mix and match.

description: 'Team, get in contact with Amiya and the Doctor—I've found it! We've finally found it!'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/300 Metres Underground. Savage raises her lantern, her suit billowing in the abyss. Deeper in the darkness, graviton accelerators link in a loop, twinkling in unison. They have noticed her arrival.

description: 'Alright, now I'm going to make the frosting! Everyone close your eyes—this is my mom's secret recipe. Doctor, I saw you sneaking a peek just now!'
dialog: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Secret Family Recipe. Savage wore this when making carrot cakes. The hand-knitted sleeves and an apron paired with a cool, breathable inner layer make it feel relaxing and distinctive.

description: Her only wish is to keep walking with you and Amiya. This year, next year, and every year after that.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Yet Another Autumn. The autumn sun shines gently, its light falling with the ginkgo leaves onto her white dress. Charlotte looks up from under her wide-brimmed hat, feeling the wind's whisper with her fingers.

description: I'd like to try an Eastern-style outfit every now and then.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Clivia. Handmade by Lungmen craftsman, this stylish outfit combines comfortable materials with cutting-edge tech and traditional handicraft. Get this spring special while it's still available!

description: For those who prioritize their safety.
dialog: Pioneer Series/Iron Block. An extremely durable product designed by Raythean Industrial, made for the harshest of environments. With the perfect combination of advanced technology and rare materials, it provides the best protection that money can buy.

description: Missions can give you a hard time. Hang in there.
dialog: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Ash. Made with special materials and designed to be functional, perfect for coping with various needs and weathering even the roughest outdoor conditions.

description: Looks surprisingly well-behaved, and is so— at least until she finishes her ice cream cone.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA008. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: Phew... Someone is knocking.
dialog: Witch Feast Series/Imp's House. A custom-made outfit for Rope that takes the young woman's activities and body shape into account. It utilizes lightweight and breathable materials, simple while not sacrificing elegance.

description: As long as they're in the studio, every knight ought to be an excellent model.
dialog: Cambrian 1097 Winter New Arrivals/Modeling Night. Tailored Kazimierzian apparel, slim-fit, highly accessorized, accompanied by a cloak in a complementary shade, sure to draw the eyes of every onlooker.

description: Thanks to the rule stating 'pets of the same species can tag out with one another', she became the arena's top contestant.
dialog: Achievement Star Collection/The Zoophilist and Her Mollusca. At the game expo, Vanilla dressed up as her 'Destiny Quest' character. The beast fight demo will be broadcast live, and the slugs in her pet cage are ready for their debut.

description: Incidentally, the title of the movie is 'Divine Palm of the Phantom Godfist - Decisive Battle II'.
dialog: MARTHE Sports Line. A limited-edition outfit commemorating FEater's 3rd Anniversary of setting the box office record. Lightweight, breathable, and comfortably-fitting. However, anyone who knows FEater also knows that she has never worn this outfit properly.

description: FEater wanted so much for the producers to add food scenes and chopstick fights to every film. Unfortunately, even though the audience loves this idea, the directors don't.
dialog: 0011 New Release / Gourmet. FEater's outfit from a bestselling Lungmen foodie film. Incorporates a sporty inner layer and a traditional knotted jacked, once all the rage.

description: The investigator desires to illuminate the castle's mysteries—
dialog: Multimedia Escape Experience 'Dreambind Castle' Visitor's Prepared Outfit/Visionblazer in the Courtyard. The outfit Mayer wore for the code-cracking event 'Courtyard Tidings.' Mayer loved all the puzzles her coworkers designed, and took to making short work of them.

description: When you work at Old Lee's office, you have to know a little of everything.
dialog: 0011 Tempest Series New Release/Wild Flower of Street. A custom Lungmen-style outfit, tight-fitting attire made entirely from aged leather. Rugged and good-looking at the same time.

description: She sees a Laterano: open, harmonized, mutualistic. Amidst the unending flow of emotion, people no longer close off their hearts. Mutual achievement, mutual comfort. Each their own self, her included.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Diversity Oneness. A possibility derived from when Virtuosa connected to the Law: emotions link together the hearts of all. The performer who once plucked at their heartstrings is now no more than a voice in the chorus.

description: After replacing manual labor with technology, Magallan discovered a new side to frosty confection-making.
dialog: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Shaved-Ice Memories. The work outfit worn by Magallan to make shaved ice during the food festival combines traditions of Higashi with characteristics of Rhine Labs. Breathable, well-insulated, and easy to move in, this outfit allows Magallan to fully devote herself to her work, even if in a shaved-ice shop.

description: It is as if time stands still here. A golden hall, a golden dream—and in the time it takes you to think this, an elf walks out from under the archway, gracing you with a smile. At that instant, time resumes its flow.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Golden Reverie. Dress carefully picked by Muelsyse. The top is bright and brazen, like the early dawnlight, and the skirt is soft and sable, like the moons playing across a still lake—a perfect union of luxury and solemnity.

description: 'But It has still left some memories behind for us. Are they mementos, or lamentations? I don't know...'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Young Branch. Water melts glacier on its way back to the soil, while wandering leaves revisit the woods. Her origins in eternal sleep, her answers long departed. But where are they now?

description: 'Pristine dreamscapes twine over the tangible in symbiosis, their fear and dread a permeation just begun. You outsiders, honored to take them on, are the first to do so—that live.'
dialog: Clothes of Phantom's, the attire he sported while staffing the 'Dreambind Castle' event. The dance as cloth, the song as silk, the threading through emotion, the tailoring by fabrication, the weave of obliteration and howling madness, it all culminates in this majestic yet skin-crawling ensemble.

description: Phantom's life is a play, but the members of the Troupe have no right to concern themselves with how it unfolds.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Focus. The attire Phantom wore when he left for the castle, and the costume of his maiden performance. After an age of gathering dust, it finally sees the light of day again.

description: Do you require help, Madam?
dialog: Cambrian 1097 Winter New Arrivals/Soft Wool. Cozy and warm standard line winter garments. With personalized coordination, you can attain your perfect balance of fashion and everyday use.

description: Tie up your laces, put on your hat, and follow your pup partner close to enjoy all that life has to offer, together.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/My Fellow Newsboy. Outfit Greyy wears when delivering newspapers. Durable jacket, sturdy boots, and checkered scarf mean he has no need to fear wind nor rain while making his way through the plazas and alleys.

description: Joy lies in absorptions, craft, and smiles and wonder on others' faces.
dialog: EPOQUE New Arrivals/Eggcellent Craftsman. Greyy made an exquisite eight-tone musical egg as a present for his close friends, and in exchange, they custom-ordered him this outfit brimming with holiday atmosphere.

description: Shamare has to give commands to the other actors to protect the treasure of the Horrorlair from pilferage. She may be the only actor here really playing herself.
dialog: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Horrorlair's Enigma' Custom Line/Echo of the Horrorlair. The actor plays the role of the Horrorlair's incarnation, patrolling its corridors and keeping it safe from the patronage of thieves.

description: Cranes the image of grace, clouds the image of gentleness. Here, a moon embroidered in red shines, a place where quarrels should be left behind.
dialog: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Celestial Crane. Outfit made from high-quality Yanese brocade, accompanied with a long ribbon of gauze. At Shamare's request, the remaining fabric was used to make a new look for Morte as well.

description: Cultivating flora, dressing herself, living a fine life; there's still a lot Podenco has to learn after she wakes up.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Wake Up From a Nap. Home leisure style, selected for Podenco by Lena. Similar colors to Podenco's original clothing, but with a complete change of style.

description: There are loads and loads of soft, squishy plush toys, along with a piece of delicious cream layer cake!
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Plush Cake. On her off days, Dur-nar changes out of her well-worn battlefield clothes to try something a little more fun. She's well versed in balancing work and play, and an expert in enjoying life.

description: Words scatter into the air, sticking by the leaves and landing in her glass. After Reed gathers them all up, only then can she put them together throughout the days and the nights.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Emerald Holiday. Reed's plain outfit during downtime. Lyrics have limits, and manuscripts have deadlines, but all that's still far, far away. They're no worry; in the comfort of the afternoon sun, finishing your glass of juice comes first.

description: The day's work is done, and it's time to buy some snacks from the street-side shops for a comfortable afternoon at home. The snacks available now are different than before, but the people enjoying them still are the same.
dialog: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/The Next Afternoon Tea. Tailored to fit snugly from lightweight hydrophobic fabric, ensuring the wearer is unhindered in water. Made to measure for Ægir residing on the land.

description: The hunters of the sea still do not understand why they need to don the strange attire of landlubbers.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Waverider Series WR04. This swimsuit tailor-made for Ægir beachgoers allows inhabitants of the sea to look dazzling on the sand.

description: 'I apply to withdraw from Rhodes Island. You've helped me plenty enough, and I will not implicate you all in what I am to do next.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Dark Cloud. Mountain's attire at his parents' funeral. Though he personally slew his own enemy, there is no hint of joy in his heart. There are still things he needs to do.

description: Status and wealth can be whisked away overnight, but the thick coverage brought by knowledge lets him stride firmly towards the future.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Book Reader. Traditional Victorian textiles and tailoring, every cut made by the hands of craftsmen, its custom-made monochrome cloth premium without being conspicuous.

description: 暂歇的骑手虽然看起来波澜不惊，但等他戴上头盔，宁静的夜里就将刻下引擎与灵魂的轰鸣声。
dialog: MARTHE运动系列新款/硬派速度。专为竞技摩托赛手设计的骑行服，采用防风面料，并在关节处进行加固处理，在保证舒适的同时提供顶级安全防护。

description: A desperate blow brought her riches and glory, but also a lifelong illness.
dialog: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Glory Purple. Zofia's attire when she participated in the Kazimierz Major awards ceremony. The right choice of attire made her the center of attention during the ceremony.

description: The film has ended, and the night has just begun. The lingering fragrance on his fingertips discloses a most dangerous signal, but it is clear that he has left no room to refuse.
dialog: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Dangerous Invitation. A graceful custom-made suit just for Arene. The stiff material is painstakingly cut to fit his youthful figure. He also personally selected the accompanying perfume.

description: Should ego not be manifest, it will vanish unto the masses.
