dialog: Cambrian 1097 Winter New Arrivals/Casual. Rainproof, wear-resistant, close-fitting yet breathing, the first choice for fashionable youth. Coloring of the lining and some accessories can be changed at the client's request, letting their no-imitation individuality pop.

description: The lifeguard's a new hire, and he specializes in cutting the sea plant tangling drowning tourists' ankles.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Beach Guard Series GT002. Made with materials that are both durable and comfortable, this outfit ensures high performance in a variety of different conditions.

description: While her sister works on the machine for the competition, Astesia quietly goes about procuring materials, managing the schedule, testing... and preparing three meals a day for the two of them.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Fantastic Crafts. Astesia and her sister wore this for a machine design competition. Lightweight, durable, and easy to clean, a stylish outfit for a hard-worker.

description: Let your heart stare hard into the stars, and witness countless flashes of glory.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Starseeker. One of the intricate outfits worn by Astesia only in the grandest occasions of Columbia's social life. Merely donning this outfit is a statement of its own.

description: Humility is left to the audience, pride belongs to the singer. This night, only I shine.
dialog: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Frlibe on the Palace. Astesia joins the project at her own expense, looking to interpret the stories written in the sky in a popular and easily accessible way.

description: The sweets she makes may have a little unexpected bitterness and sourness, but the feelings she wishes to share are always sweet as sugar.
dialog: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Half-sweet Strawberry. Outfit Grace wears while making holiday-appropriate sweets. A simple apron meets a clash of bold black against daring red, proof that there is no contradiction between reserved expression and sincere intent.

description: The adept ventures to unravel the castle's secrets—
dialog: Multimedia Escape Experience 'Dreambind Castle' Visitor's Prepared Outfit/Cleansweeper in the Castle. The outfit Shaw wore for the investigation event 'Trails in the Castle.' While Shaw trawls the castle scenery, she's prepared to fend off unexpected guests at any time.

description: 'I didn't understand back then... I gave them form, but could not manage warmth or life. But now I do, which is why they're always a beautiful shade of pure white, while I'm always draped in black.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Twines of Time. Orchid finally completed her design after several torturous nights. She stroked the delicate stitches on it, quietly praying for life.

description: 'Don't worry, she won't get away. As you said, if she and I are the only people in this world who can't see eye to eye, then nobody is better suited to be her nemesis than me.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Titleless Code. The outfit worn by Executor when tracking important charges for the Laterano Notarial Hall. Though one's identity may change over the years, what the heart desires does not.

description: 此刻的她，与那不曾相见的镜中影，两个人的成长不会只是泡影一场。
dialog: 忒斯特收藏系列/幽然灵竹。由异国国主的礼服微调而成的着装。无需神秘的力量，泡普卡在经历时光的洗礼之后，逐渐有了新的改变。

description: Wait! Someone stop her! Why's she running around on her chainsaw like it's a broom?! The training room floor can't take any more!
dialog: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/Witch's Swing. She plays the role of the young witch brought by her dark mistress to gain some experience! Who says a witch's swing has to be a broom? A chainsaw works too!

description: 'Three, two, one, firing water round!'
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD66. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

description: 'Did you see it, my lovely mistress? Are you not pleased with this banquet of blood and darkness— Ow... If you want to fight, don't start with the face...'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Seventh Night's Awakened. An outfit worn by Midnight during the promotional video of an annihilation operation. Though it was undeniably effective, everyone agreed that it was a bit over-the-top.

description: 'We done shooting yet? No? Listen, director lady, I don't wanna get you rated for obscenities, but can you not waste my precious freaking time along with yours?'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Professional. The outfit Spot wore for an Annihilation mission promo. It might've been effective, but all Spot's thinking about is what cartoons are on tonight.

description: 'I couldn't perform any tasks while I was afloat, so the only thing I could do was compute something interesting. According to my calculations over these last three months, the logic of space and time takes the form of the lovely Ms. Closure.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Shore Rescue Modification. Lancet-2 was unexpectedly shot down into the water while aiding Ægir refugees off the coast of Iberia, and remained afloat for three months until located and retrieved by a Rhodes Island search and rescue team.

description: It's even harder to tell it apart from a medical robot with this new paint job.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Raythean Style SUMMER Special Painting. Equipped with heat-proof coating, the latest sand wheels, and reinforced engineering. It is specially modified for operations on the beach.

description: 'She walked down the towering steps, one by one, like a goddess descending from the mountains.' Everyone was stunned into silence by Matoimaru's performance. They could not help but wonder: Is she an acting genius? Or is she actually—
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Frosted Steps. Outfit Matoimaru wore when taking part in a period piece. An elegant Higashinese dress combined with delicate makeup bring out her hidden charms in all their glory.

description: Bringing an all-new 'flame,' wheeling about in the battlefield they call 'music.'
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Black Wave. Stage clothing picked by guitarist Vigna herself. The outfit in whole has been languishing in Vigna's wardrobe for a while, and she's always wanted to give it a stage showing. The chance has now arrived.

description: Perfect for getting that lovely tan.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD01. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

description: 'Captain, I'll handle things here. You're still needed elsewhere.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Distinguished Visitor. The outfit worn by Angelina while she was stationed at the 2nd Final Defense Front. The substance of reality slowly flows between her fingers and her tools.

description: Aww, I can't finish all these cakes on my own. What do I do~
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA017. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: 'Once more has the tide returned to Iberia, and it follows the point of my sword. Do you hear the command of the waves as they crash upon the shore? They call upon Iberia to set sail once more.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Blade-cleaved Tides. Thorns bares his blade, and Iberia's fleet sets sail after a century of silence. A golden secret has emerged in lawless lands, and seas of sand and salt can no longer conceal its radiance.

description: Have fun on vacation. Do not disturb at work.
dialog: I.T Brand UNDER GARDEN Collab Outfit/Cómodo. A black and white base, the third color freely selectable. A casual design, a multi-modular composition for balanced action/everyday effect.

description: 'And Leon's armed like a weaponized tin can now. Fine, at least we all know what we're doing.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Tested One. Ayerscarpe's attire while upgrading the Rim Billiton Weapon Distribution Center weapons system. He needs to infiltrate a Catastrophe area together with his friends, and heist an important piece of data back before the Columbians.

description: Harmonie rarely allows anyone into her study, a private space for her alone. The room is furnished with elegant furniture, but she is happy to sit on the table with her tail slightly raised, her staff teasing the sunlight.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Invitation. A set of formalwear Harmonie wears while enjoying the afternoon in her study. The smart tailoring makes her skirt move in a beautiful curve, and the fabrics are specially chosen to hide any stray fur stuck on her clothes.

description: On special occasions, Harmonie will redecorate her room, paying meticulous attention to every detail, all for the sake of appeasing her long-lost maiden's heart.
dialog: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Decoration. A cute dress Harmonie rarely wears. With its adjustable fit and flexible materials, it can accentuate the body's natural curves better than any other. The accessories are all from her beloved private collection.

description: There's no end to the race with the reaper; you've always got to take a proper break.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA026. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: The palm tree sticker was given to her by a surf shop owner during her last trip to Siesta, and the Lupo sticker is from her trip before that to Columbia, where an arcade manager awarded it for a new high score. Both adorn her suitcase. Who knows what she can get on her next trip?
dialog: Cambrian 1100 Winter New Arrivals/Travel Freely. A red and white baseball jacket over a black hoodie, paired with drawstring pants and sports shoes. Comfy and casual, unrestrictive and lightweight, suited for day-to-day travel.

description: 'There's still the Holy City and Kazdel left... You really give me the worst headaches, Mostima. Once I find you, I'm going to punch you in the face.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Judgment Day. Gun-Knight Fiammetta returns to where her squad fell apart. Fragments of time have turned into vicious beasts, intent on bringing everything in the area into stasis. Without the slightest hesitation, she pulls the trigger.

description: 'Stop passing around my character card! I mean it! Divine Oath and Crimson Fury are just made up for the game, not my new codenames!'
dialog: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Dominions & Dogma' Custom Line/Divine Oath. This player shall be the apostolic knight who takes charge in times of crisis. She is the crimson fury spilling forth from the Holy Spirit's palm, bearing the eternal burden of seeking the land of salvation.

description: After browsing the massive CD collection, Cutter settled on a series teaching kitchen skills. She'll put in the work so that next time, she won't get banned from the kitchen again!
dialog: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Wiping Knife. A style trending among the youth. Tight yet breathable, with an avant-garde design. Noted for its high-contrast colors and modular buckles, letting the wearer freely express themselves.

description: She should have made proper plans before setting off on her trip. Now, the blistering heat is right by her side while the shade is far away. She can only take in the sun while she figures something out.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD29. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

description: Civilization's trash is nature's treasure.
dialog: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Tranquil Moss. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made with special materials suited for all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.

description: When 'Destiny Quest' launched, the wandering scholar watched over the ruins, welcoming the hero to the start of their rough-and-tumble journey. Leizi doubted her motives, broke down her words, searched all over for her secrets, before finally unlocking the hidden level after the end of the game.
dialog: Achievement Star Collection/The Archivist and Her Pilgrimage. Clothes Leizi wore at a game expo. She plays a mysterious wandering scholar with a magical companion. Her dedication was praiseworthy, and she brought a true ending to the story.

description: Blink and you'll miss it. You'll never forget it when you see it.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Honor and Splendor. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, this outfit synergizes a wide variety of practical fabrics, providing a truly holistic look to meet exacting demands while still maintaining an affordable price.

description: Most hotheaded troublemakers back off for their own safety, seeing the iron hammer she's carrying.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Obsidian. Mudrock's work outfit. Mudrock made rounds between every facility at the venue, ensuring the performance would go without a hitch. Though working behind the scenes, she nevertheless opted for a disguise of sorts so as not to disturb the audience.

description: Yes, this is Mudrock, our young and beautiful Sarkaz lady.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Silent Night Series DN06. The material is light, soft, breathable and durable. The latest design that is as enchanting as it is elegant.

description: To the Children of Soil and Stone, decaying ruins can quickly become a set of Kazdelian houses.
dialog: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Rubble. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made of special materials suited for all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.

skinName.en: Remedy In A Cup Of Leung Cha

description: A leung cha store is not just for leung cha, and the office is not just for work. As Lee would say, this is where you'll find the human touch in Lungmen. After all, no matter if someone's here for leung cha or a detective, what they're really looking for is peace of mind.

description: He did not find his favorite crystals on the beach, but the coolness of drinks and sea breeze made it worth his while.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HDm57. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

description: The golden sunlight is not the only visitor to this room. The ocean has just revealed itself, and Lumen gestures at you to speak softly so as to not disturb the dreamlike scene.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Golden Dream. Lumen's casual leisure wear, tailored for elegance from lightweight materials. The sea mist has lifted, and you can now see the lighthouse without binoculars.

description: Through bustling cities and endless crowds, he was just a small piece of the land. Now, and always, he is no longer alone.
dialog: Brand Collaborative Series/Wanderer in the Rain. Raindrops slide down his clear umbrella to his feet, and the night wind lifts the hem of his white coat. Though the path ahead remains unclear, he knows where to go.

description: The story goes from day to night and back, but not all stories are meant to be told right away. Hot drinks and beautiful scenery are everything tonight. A poem yet unread can wait for tomorrow.
dialog: Erato's home attire/Untold Stories. Soft, tight-fitting fabric with a thick and comfy scarf; comfortable attire for relaxing at home.

description: Heidi has sent a thousand letters, ranging from her teenage dreams to heartfelt essays, keeping the replies in a box she carries around. She has met some of her recipients, but others she will never hear from again.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Thousand Correspondences. A custom outfit made of fine and lightweight material, tailored based on Heidi's descriptions of her childhood summers. Though it feels different from how she remembers.

description: 'My duty, my obligation, the shame of my nobility, and the golden cage that I oh so hate... this is my path.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Eine Variation. A traditional-style gown worn by every Graf Urtica, now draped over Ebenholz's shoulders. Orders apathetically seep from the tip of the staff, piercing through the sparse ensemble of nobles.

description: The wild hills form the staves, adorned by the notes of Gloompincers rolling helplessly in the wind. Czerny takes out pen and paper, writing down music with nature, believing that he can perfect its work.
dialog: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Freeland Tuneseeker. Made with special materials with function in mind, perfect for meeting your various needs and weathering even the roughest conditions.

description: This is not the first time Dorothy has taken on the role of the lord of the realm. To weave a fantasy, to direct an adventure, to achieve everyone else's hopes and dreams... She has always been like this.
dialog: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Dominions & Dogma' Custom Line/Hand of Destiny. This player shall be the will of the realm behind the story. She is neither a wicked god, nor a righteous spirit. All she does is let the players roll the dice.

description: 'Tis a shame that the sunlight always shines upon this plow for far too short. But before that spring, she still did not understand such things.
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Noon Twilight. Absinthe's former school uniform. In Ursus, students wear their uniforms while exercising, resembling a field of neatly spaced seedlings behind a plow.

description: 碧波与海风的二重奏，搭配上远处羽兽的和声，这一次不用录音器，她用双耳记录下这首美妙的夏日之曲。
dialog: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣91款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description: She smiles as she says: 'Admiring all these lanterns with you tonight is warmer than the countless sunsets I've seen in the wilds.'
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/By the Lamplight. Clothes Surfer wore while sightseeing during the lantern display. A dignified, elegant jacket is draped over an avant-garde red silk top, just like the wearer's cautious exterior hides a daring heart.

description: Minimalist fought all day to build his sandcastle, until at last the unfinished project was toppled by a stiff wind. Then he decided to take a break.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HDm74. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

description: As line after line appears on the page, Pozëmka's thoughts drift to the night of her flight. The north wind brings the snow, while a bright fire burns in the fireplace. The gas lamp outside the tent flickers, unable to light her unpredictable path.
dialog: Vitafield [Camper] Series Classics/Snowy Plains in Words. The layered fabric keeps the wearer warm, while the closed sleeves and pants keep the wind and snow out.

description: Stronger drink will not make this fantasy any more real. It is unknown when the moons' light seeped into her dreams. Please pack away these curious thoughts properly, and don't let the Yanese read her half-written work.
dialog: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Beside Dreams. A sheer robe woven from Yanese muslin, paired with a magnolia hairpin. Returned to seclusion, brush in hand beside spring's window, the mortal realm meets ethereal dreams.

description: One day, the stars will fall to the earth, entering the eternal cycles of history. As for the power to flip the pages of the chronicle of fate, that lies in Pepe's hands.
dialog: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Nuit of the Nightsky. Reed flutes and harps play in succession as jade lotuses gently float by. The night sky and melodic notes accompany Pepe in a moment where she has pushed everything else to the back of her mind.

description: The hunter returns home, leaving the snows far behind him for a spell. This is a story about a reclusive youth's arrow, and his days in Sargon's rainforests.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SDm09 for men. Tight-fitting, lightweight, breathable, and designed for the summer.

description: Quartz nearly fell over the first time she put on high heels, but she quickly got used to them, going back to her usual cool self in front of the camera—Oh no, she's not trying to look cool, she just doesn't know what expression to make! Go help her, quick!
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Cover Mercenary. Clothes Quartz wore when she was invited to a magazine shoot. Minimalist yet stylish, daring yet elegant. A mercenary's aura adds a touch of mystique to this outfit.

description: He has spent a long time searching, yet is still where he started. The night before news arrived of a Nearl family swordstaff entering Leithanien, he could not help seeing some long-lost silhouettes through the torrential rain.
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/W Dali. Młynar's attire as a knight-errant, wandering Kazimierz's plains and endless forests, the words engraved on the hilt of his sword not yet covered by useless trinkets.

description: 'If you wish to go, they cannot stop you, but you wouldn't be able to live with yourself, would you? You cannot sit idly by while darkness becomes the master of all. So go, show them how a spear forged of light shall never break.'
dialog: Iteration Provident/Roar Against the Wilds. Młynar's iteration from decision point F/3019226. The Black Riders have finally arrived at the Forgotten Plains, but the Hermit Knight chooses not to leave. Instead, he bars the way, alone.

description: A parting is not always caused by cruelty, just as a record does not always stem from remembrance.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Scribing. The dust settles, the noise stops, and Nuova Volsinii finally quiets down. Here, the judge sheds her robes of the law, and with pen in hand, she writes of the turmoil that once rocked Siracusa.

description: A judge must be ever vigilant and rational, but sometimes Lavinia allows herself to get lost in her cup. In her inebriated dreams, her mailbox is filled with letters and gifts of appreciation.
dialog: Penance's casual outdoor wear/Occasionally Flushed. Sometimes, Lavinia will tolerate a hint of aqua between her otherwise pure black skirt and white coat.

description: Highmore searches along the seashore. The warm light of the lantern shines upon countless tiny carapaces and bleached bones. They are stranded in the shallows, far, far from home in both distance and time. Highmore stops to listen to the sea breeze, and the nostalgic song it carries.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Stranded. Recreation of clothes Highmore wore in her hometown. Custom-made flexible support materials keep the skirt puffy, while ribbons of pure white gently sway, giving form to the unknowable sea breeze.

description: I arrive there as I arrive here when wandering mount and sea. The sun, moons and full blossoms gift their scents to you as they do me.
dialog: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/The Land With Me. Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, inspired by Yanese landscape paintings. Thanks to weaving and dyeing techniques rarely seen in the modern age, mounts and seas emerge from the nichang's fabric, blurring fantasy and reality.

description: Raindrops drown out footsteps, the crowd comes and goes, and no one notices that she has stopped. It is an unremarkable city, but she remembers how long it took for her to cross the ruins and wastes to set foot here.
dialog: 0011 Tempest Series/The Road to Here. Loose-fitting coat that can envelop a young girl. The waterproof fabric makes it suitable for a rainy day.

description: Stainless hesitatingly told his granny that he made these clothes 'all in his own time' with 'scrap materials'. Catherine didn't scold him, though. All she said was that his craftsmanship was still a bit shoddy.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Empty Crown. Outfit Stainless tailored for himself. With unique armor designs and bold weapon modifications, he has successfully recreated the image of a heroic knight in his heart.

description: A seaside trip requires a speedboat, and a boat requires a trustworthy engineer. He's ready and waiting, so just say the word.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Beach Guard Series GT003. Made with materials that are both durable and comfortable, this outfit ensures high performance in a variety of different conditions.

description: 'Just a quick spray here, here, aaand here. Purrfect! Yes, my graffiti's quite remeowkable, if I say so myself! Quick, snap a picture of us together!'
dialog: Monster Hunter Collaborative Series/Fly Into the Street. The Felynes are amped with excitement for getting some Terra-style fresh fits on, and spray paint-filled cans especially pique their curiosity. Noir Corne senses something big and bad's about to go down.

description: The new leaves float the boat, while the flower blooms on.
dialog: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Away From Dust. Made by expert Yanese tailors, the stylish, narrow-sleeved robe is cool and comfortable. Jieyun wore it while visiting Yan's rivers and lakes.

description: Lucilla hypothesizes that there are yet more marine species out there that are being driven to extinction by the Seaborn, but she does not have the leisure to grieve for them for long. She tries to dig up more information, all the better to make traps for capturing Seaborn. She's already got plenty of new ideas.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Tidal Bore. Clothes Lucilla wore when looking around an exhibit about extinct marine species. The eye is led down the outfit by the changes in color mimicking seawater at different depths, punctuated by unique patterns to form a calm, tranquil ensemble.

description: 即使无人知晓，也要默默积攒知识和经验，绝不停下脚步，而朋友正是让她们能坚持下去的魔法。
dialog: 小马宝莉合作服装/求知的魔法。深夜之时，她们还在知识的魔法世界中遨游。她们背负起应尽的责任，为了自己，也为了身边的人。

description: My gaze falls upon clearest ice and coldest jade, arrayed hither and tither. The Qionghua blooms of the celestial realm know my heart, and refuse to wither. —Inscribed in Lin Yühsia's study
dialog: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Heavenly Mirage. Recreation of a Lungmen VIP's childhood fantasy. She enters the Xians' abode, dressed in celestial garb, skirts dark as kohl, jade pure as ice, face austere, serene. Transcendent.

description: 'Lin the Violet' handles her accounts, while 'Fins the Colorful' swim about in circles. You and I are neither Lin nor Fin, so how can we know of what joy and pain lie within?
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA137. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: Warmy trudges onwards and onwards, all so she can have the best bread in the neighborhood, though she ends up lost. Falling snow flutters through the night sky, and the scent of the bread in her hand cutting through the chilly air proves irresistible. Forget it, let's sit down and eat it while it's hot!
dialog: Cambrian 1100 Winter New Arrivals/Warm Velvet At the Corner. A warm coat, both thick and lightweight, winter boots for icy, snow-laden roads, and a white knit cap complete with a bright bow. Proof you don't have to sacrifice warmth for cuteness.

description: Shapeless sword, formless air, sights of seasons also bare. Guests of groves and guests of tea, snow and wind shall come to thee.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Courtesy. Lungmen's latest trend, seamlessly blending ancient and modern Yanese charm. To Qiubai, the art of tea and the sword are the same in that both require full attention and to know when to stop.

description: How long can an old tree stand in the wind and sand? How far can one little boat go? Put your sword away in your rucksack along with the autumn sights.
dialog: Brand Collaborative Series/Wine-flushed is Woods of Rime. Wind-proof and wear-resistant with a clean, slim fit that's easy to move in. Inspired by the northwest poplar forests.

description: With a letter home, the bell's toll resounds; Across a thousand li, two moons share the same sky.
dialog: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Moon under the Pines. Classic Yanese clothes, mixing tradition with modern craftsmanship. Wind Chimes leans against a tree, watching the moonlight shine in the water, her skirt like a shimmering ripple. What will you dream of tonight?

description: 'That expression on Ines's face—that crisp, cool distance—is simply a perfect fit for the dreamy ambiance this shoot needs. Just how does she do it?' 'Hah, bet she's thinking up ways to kill you all later.'
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Melodic Flutter. Clothes Ines wore when posing for a music-themed portrait. The magnificent dress is a perfect match for the music, as the butterflies dance to the melody, bringing the reverie to life in vivid detail.

description: The demon who manipulates shadow reveals herself amongst the drifting embers, inscribing fear above the wailing plains.
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Under the Flaming Dome. As artillery splits the heavens, all is as it ever was. Ines arrives at the city, ready to rewrite Kazdel's once inevitable ending of destruction.

description: Even during more laid-back days, Hoederer still takes the measure of his experiences.
dialog: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Courtyard of Neka. Out of curiosity, Hoederer knocks open the door to an ancient courtyard. He stands before a tranquil pond, engraving the beauty he stumbled upon into his memory.

description: 'All my friends watching out there, this is your favorite Streamer U! Look! Check out where I'm coming at you live from! What do you think? This must be that 'cloud streaming' everyone's been talking about lately!'
dialog: Brand Collaborative Series/Stream Above The Clouds. She wakes up atop a cloud in her favorite childhood dress, surrounded by all her friends, and through her daze senses a freedom she hasn't felt in a long time—wait, why's she streaming with her phone?!

description: The weather vane points to today's destination. Her felt friends escort her there, while every nameless roadside flower blooms among her idle thoughts. She may soon leave again, but her time here will be forever preserved in poetry.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sent from Ognisko. Clothes Viviana wore on a short return trip to Ognisko, a pure linen dress paired with a knitted shawl. With these, she wanders the city of shady trees and the sounds of artisans.

description: Finish up your workout, enjoy the gentle light of the sunset, have some fruit. Now that's what I call a good time!
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA083. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: Her gaze is not solely focused on a future of bitter frost. She also peeks at a warm day spent frolicking through the forest.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Midskog Fika. Celebratory dress prepared by Valarqvin for a rare day of melted snow. Adorned with bright grass and flower motifs, which are infused with beautiful meaning in Sami.

description: A sudden burst of daylight, and she dances with the dust.
dialog: Striker Series/Dawnbreak. A product of Raythean Industries, made for mechanized combat, combining fashionable colors with punk style. Multi-purpose bandoliers ensure efficiency even in complex environments, providing absolute freedom.

description: Almond looks around her. Sesame balls, green peas, biscuits, jujubes... All in all, a very sweet dream. But she soon realizes she's at the center of the platter. 'Hey, am I one of the snacks—?!'
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Almond Platter. Outfit Almond wore during a field mission in Yan. Deep crimsons are a natural complement to the festive atmosphere, while the long skirt and wide sleeves bring out her latent cuteness.

description: New day, new job. Enis rushes down. Nothing can stop him from meeting life head-on.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Vibrant. Clothes Enis wears when he's in a good mood. Specially chosen for him by his family. Close-fitting, snug and easy to move around in.

description: The fowlbeasts were flocking around the 'Scarecrow', so Verdant decided to rest a little in the plaza, taking in the bright sunshine and petals wafting in the wind. Not a bad combo, he thought.
dialog: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Rose Rider. Outfit Verdant wears when passing along the love of others. A casual and leisurely ensemble. The red jacket and the design on the jeans go well with the festive roses.

description: After the transfiguration of his tuba, Bassline lets out a rare smile of pure joy as he flies through the air with everyone's help. With a wave of his wand, stars appear in the sky.
dialog: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/Starry Night Sky. He plays the role of the guide showing the hero the way. The Golden Movement has long since faded, but the stars he shoots will forever point true north.

description: With fashion experts' guidance, Tomimi's trying a new style. We'll have to see—can it get something tickling in Gavial's mind?
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Silent Night Series DN04. The material is light, soft, breathable and durable. The latest design that is as enchanting as it is elegant.

description: In times like these, when ice and snow rage outside the window, you should get a cup of hot cocoa, write love-filled letters to your wife and daughter, and throw in a comment on how cute the souvenir pajamas you gave them are. In short, he is rather pleased with himself.
dialog: Harold's home attire/Inviting Snow. A burdenbeast neck pillow, burdenbeast pajamas, burdenbeast slippers. A full burdenbeast ensemble, very popular in Kjerag right now!

skinName.en: The Shadow of the Dark Moon

description: It's rare to see Degenbrecher with such a furrowed brow and intense concentration on her face. After a long while, she finally finds the perfect angle, navigating the witch hat past her horns so it can sit atop her head. She breathes a sigh of relief.
dialog: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/The Shadow of the Dark Moon. She plays the role of the witch guarding the grimoire. The tome is of no use to her. Instead, it is her sword that renders her unstoppable: 'Come, try to defeat me.'

description: Ray's not entirely sure what 'stage decorations' are supposed to be, but after consulting with Lanns and Potlid, she decided to use a mine excavator as the 'main visual' thingamabob.
dialog: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Dreaming High. With high-grade sandbeast feed on a Rim Billiton regional audition's prize list, Ray doesn't mind taking on a new challenge.

description: 潮湿的空气捎来夏日的温度，微弱的虫鸣渲染平静的时刻。骑着单车从人声鼎沸的海边来到隐秘的休息处，她任自己的思绪与回忆在景色中静静流淌。
dialog: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣098款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description: 'Why is it that the crops Wanqing harvests always turn out so good?' 'They don't just get a lot of natural sunlight, they get the light of his pearly whites too. With that much sunshine, how can you not end up tasty as heck?'
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Tons of Sunshine. Clothes Wanqing wears for work. White singlet, tight-fitting yet breathable pants, and a dirt-repellent apron. A simple ensemble that becomes harmony itself on him.

description: A chivalrous young swordsman has come to the Tianshi Bureaus. It is said he traversed the lands and learned much on his travels, but to hear a story from him, you must first duel him. Learning of this, the young Tianshis rolled up their sleeves, thinking of asking him for 'guidance'.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Youthful Journey. Outfit Zuo Le wore when using the Tianshi Bureaus' training grounds. Integrated with elements of the Tianshi gown, enabling mobility while highlighting his youthful spirit.

description: A humble piece on the board, his path diverged from all others. Adversity hardened him, gifted him growth; at the decisive moment, he would break the deadlock.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Quiet Move. A master move made by Zuo Le. He has played his own shadow across boards and grids. Over time, he learned that while the patterns are many, the wisdom behind them is one.

description: Fragrant dumplings of jade, lightly wound in brightest thread. Mount and stream bright and green, around orchids do we tread.
dialog: 0011 Yun Series/Fragrant Pace. A jacket and skirt woven by Dahuang's weavers for the festivities, gifted to Grain Buds to wear as she wanders the fields. Around her, the wonders of nature. By her side, fine friends to be sure.

description: Safehouse, safe harbor, outlet for creativity and expression.
dialog: Rainbow Six Collaborative Series/Safehouse. A set of clothes that Ela bought at the market. Light and comfortable, it is her favorite outfit in the safehouse. She particularly likes how the local hat looks on her.

description: Perhaps the world is a maze of mirrors, looking very different when a few rays of light go through it.
dialog: Rainbow Six Collaborative Series/Mirrormaze. Iana's casual outfit for her free time. She has changed into a pair of shorts, hoping that the sun here is different. Perhaps she will not need her hood.

description: Time is the roadside exhibit. Visitors walk toward the exit, connected to the future.
dialog: Rainbow Six Collaborative Series/Exhibition. Picked by Doc based on practical requirements, offering protection against wind, dust, and cold as he goes to the next place that needs him. Of that, there is never a shortage.

description: Dressed in beautiful clothes, and flying a kite during a beautiful spring day. Now, these last wishes were complete. Lutonada wants to hop down from the wall, but she didn't expect a fowlbeast to nip at her bracelet. She hesitates for a moment, before deciding to stay a little longer.
dialog: 0011 Yun Series/Whispered Longing. Clothes Lutonada wore while taking a spring walk through Yan. An organic mixture of traditional and modern elements form a refreshing, graceful style that does not sacrifice charm. All sorts of accessories add to the cuteness.

description: Red and black may be the typical Kazdel colors, but for some reason, after wearing these clothes, Odda finds his steps much, much lighter.
dialog: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/Candy Strike. Clothes Odda changed into to fit the neighborhood event's theme. Featuring bright colors and breathable materials, suited for anyone who enjoys outdoor exercise.

description: 'I once danced, chasing the flame, but they feared me, and ultimately abandoned me. They have forgotten what sort of power hides in the dark. Come with me. If this thousand years without night has an end, I will cut down each and every sun myself.'
dialog: Iteration Provident/Phototaxis. Ascalon's iteration from decision point F/3019226. She bids it stay for the sake of the lives of countless unbelievers, but the Seventh Sun is still determined to fall.

description: Pain, rage, sorrow, joy... Logos silently sits at the peak of the spire, allowing the music to wash over him, allowing the emotions to envelop him. Finally, he picks up his pen, a composition rising from his heart.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Radiant Serenity. Clothes Logos wore as a guest at the Liches' spire. Golden moons and stars adorn a base of blue-gray fabric, graceful yet profound.

description: Ere twilight's fall, we bid farewell in the darkness.
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Condolence. Attire worn by Civilight Eterna during her Deep Dive into Theresa's data. Through the veil of time, she spots memories sealed by the dead.

description: 'What caused us to lose our voices is still unclear, but no doubt it has close ties to Originium. Go, my sisters, go to Aefanyl's side.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Primordial Ode. PhonoR-0 is draped in the lace veil her sisters embroidered with incantations, singing an ode above the Valley. The Banshees have finally found their voice once more.

description: The curtain falls without a single mistake during the performance. Even without a pen, Underflow is able to freely analyze and connect all the details. She enjoyed this holistic work, and gives it her sincere admiration.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Laminar Flow. Clothes Underflow wore to the theater in Ægir. Lightweight armor and a tailored skirt come together to form a balance between comfort and defense.

description: As you pass through the gloomy corridors of the Hospital of Horror and creep ever closer to its secrets, the roar of a chainsaw behind you reminds you that nobody can escape from its terrors.
dialog: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/The Chainsaw Nurse. Outfit of the nurse from the Hospital of Horror in the story. Her gigantic chainsaw and conspicuous sutures are proof enough that she, the first masterpiece, lives on to this very day.

description: 即使身处困境，她们也会敞开心扉，坦荡荡地展露出最真实的自己。她们一直都是这样诚实。
dialog: 小马宝莉合作服装/率直诚实之人。她们热情又可靠，像阳光下散发清香气味的苹果一样，时刻用笑容感染他人，给予大家勇气。

description: Though her journey to her next objective feels like it is endless, she believes every step she takes is infused with meaning.
dialog: Achievement Star Collection/The Next Side Quest. Clothes Papyrus picked during character creation in 'Dark Age of Terra'. She never stops running about the game, recording all the stories she can find in this new world.

description: Time is not a thing you can buy with gems, no matter how many of them you offer. It is for this reason that Sand Reckoner is willing to enjoy this little break.
dialog: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Horus' Rest. Lazvar understands that even clockwork fowlbeasts occasionally need a break from yellow sands and clamorous crowds, finding a moment's rest on branches.

description:
'Balanced Diet General Laios, Disciplined Lifestyle General Chilchuck, and Moderate Exercise General Senshi! Heed my command—Devour them!'
Marcille makes sure to practice her more dramatic lines before every performance.
dialog: Brand Collaborative Series/Terra & Traveller. Clothes Marcille wears when telling stories of her adventures aboard Rhodes Island. She acts as she imagines the Lunatic Magician would, summoning several familiars with a wave of her hand. Some of them even look like our operators!

description: His body is Ægir's future taking form. That future may end up as his shackles... but Ulpianus does not hesitate.
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Staring into the Abyss. Clothes Ulpianus wore when taking charge of the Abyssal Hunter Program. The consul's transformation is already complete, yet the ceremonial sword in his hand has taken on a great weight.

description: Walking under the arches, crossing over the small bridge, and turning yet another corner amidst the shrubs. But no matter where she may be in the garden, she is always the most mesmerizing of the flowers.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Blooming Reverie. Satin dress Nymph chose for herself. The fluttering hem complements her flower-shaped updo, turning her into an elegant fairy dancing in the garden, lively and graceful.

description: After trying the desserts Nymph brought along, there is not a soul who is not wondering about the secret behind their incredible sweetness.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sweetness to the Heart. Outfit Nymph put together in preparation for the tea party. Light and comfortable, with just the right amount of sweetness. Maybe she has her own sugary secret recipe?

description: No need to rush to handle the sacrifices the nurse nabbed without a sweat. Once he's done with maintaining the mannequin, his exhilarating and delightful grand experiment shall begin again.
dialog: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/Under Surgical Lights. Outfit of the doctor from the Hospital of Horror in the story. With bloodstained bandages and a wrapped-up mannequin, the mad doctor picks up his scalpel, searching for the secrets of the human body beyond ethical reach.

description: With feet dipped in vibrant color, and a heart filled with blossoms, she gracefully opens her fan, singing a song of newborn hope.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/An Opera of Flowers. Costume Philae wore while taking part in a traditional Yanese opera. A pale pink robe boasts sleeves of pure white, drawing in even graceful butterflies, who flutter about and rest by her side.

description: 'Been learning for so long. Now I can finally go take on all those strong guys. Yeah, relax. I'll be a little civilized about it.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Gorgeous Flower. Flint's attire when she set out on a lone journey, a 'Catastrophe Messenger' by her own declaration. Before, her fists only knew Acahualla and Rhodes Island. Now, it's Terra's turn.

description: A revenant's self-identity is ever-changing. The way they see themselves is often different from what we perceive.
dialog: Test Collection Series/Phase Face. Clothes that show off both Tin Man's classical and surrealist sides. The final design was put together using Furnace illusions. A sense of strangeness blurs the line between illusion and reality.

description: Shadows of flitting feathers wi' golden osmanthus pluck'd, attend the gentleman who, with scissors sharp, shapes fair autumns' husks.
dialog: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Autumn Shadow. Clothes Figurino made himself from Yanese materials after talking to local craftsmen. The craftsmen sent him some shadow puppets, and ever since, the silhouette of the one he cares for appears in the window.

description: 'Gavial, I'll keep Rhodes Island safe in your stead.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Forgemaster. Rhodes Island Engineering Chief Eunectes's outfit while refitting an experimental-model Raging Ironhide. Every point worked on all by herself, everyone saying she's much more reliable than Closure. Closure fiercely rolling her eyes.

description: HP, restored! Consumables, plenty! Alright, enough dawdling, let's get that treasure!
dialog: Achievement Star Collection/The Starting Point. Clothes Rose Salt wears while playing an adventure game. Carefree, she sits in front of the game console, slipping on her headphones. She's ready to loot hoards of treasure in the realm of fantasy.

description: 此刻，跨过无数羽兽连成的桥梁，她将与最令人惊叹的天空景色相遇。
dialog: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/渡澄空。炎国匠人为云迹特别设计的服饰，宽松款裙装搭配纨扇和飘带，让她无论在哪一片天空中都能怡然自在。

description: 欢迎我们的啦啦队长！有钼铅在，就永远不会冷场！
dialog: MARTHE运动系列新款/跃动节拍。特殊弹力纤维制成的啦啦队服，在保障轻便灵活的同时兼顾了透气舒适性。挥舞花球的钼铅将注定是全场的焦点。

description: 'Move over a little, a little bit more... Okay, I'm taking the photo now! Thank you for going out of your way to come to my graduation ceremony. Can I keep this photo? I'd like to use it as a bookmark.'
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Spring in Her Lens. Clothes Xingzhu wore to her nutritional science course graduation ceremony. With a billowing deep blue robe paired with a lilac Yanese satin jacket, she is ready for the lens to capture her smile.

description: The hour has reached a quiet dusk. Here, he brings the rest they deserve to souls destined to depart.
dialog: Iteration Provident/The Spirit Farer. Nowell's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Among graves in the glimmer, the spirit farer stands upon a wooden bridge at dusk, guiding all souls into a new cycle.

description: All of her bedtime stories are similar to the ones she's heard before. After you listen to them, your dreams tonight might end up showing you the same sights she's seen during her travels.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bedtime Story. Brigid's 'housewear' she chose for herself. Even if there's rarely a warm room to enjoy oneself in, it can still grant the hasty a moment of calm.

description: Through danger comes transformation; from clarity comes renewal.
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Sharpened Claws. Mon3tr's new uniform after the most important reunion. Once again breaking through the theoretical limits of evolution and reconstruction, redefining the highest levels of sharpness and resilience.

description: Fearing not oblivion, she bears it all.
dialog: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Master of Melodia. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She is the Creator of the Haven, Ave Mujica. She awaits in stilled elegance, that she would entice her audience unto this world.

description: Fearing not death, she confronts her each and every self.
dialog: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Marionette's Id. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. By her own fingers she will puppet the strings, unseal the closed box, and grant freedom to every doll.

description: Draped in lies, she confronts that for which she sorrows.
dialog: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Caged Singer. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She will spurn not the cage but accept her shackles, so she might continue to sing.

description: Risking her all, she confronts that which she loves.
dialog: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Magician of Passion. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. For as easily as she will scry your hearts, so one can scarcely scry hers.

description: Baring her heart, she confronts that which she fears.
dialog: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Moonlight Executioner. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She will carry out her mission wordlessly, so she might protect the place where she truly belongs.

description: Who will remember the names erased, who will watch over the times long buried, who will cradle the sincerest hope, and who has always listened for the people?
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Purification of the Past. All history is destined to fade like smoke. The millennia past have turned to a handful of dust, and Gracebearer leans by forgotten waters, wishing only to wash away all the clamor of bygone days.

description: 今天的蒂比不是在幕后忙来忙去的工作人员，在这个布景里，她是唯一的主角。
dialog: EPOQUE系列新款/清新布景。蒂比参加迷你剧演出时的着装。清凉的夏装，附带一顶带着阳光味道的草帽，让镜头捕捉下少女最自然的姿态。

description: Quietly listen to her prayer: may all living beings be granted the radiance they deserve.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Requiem Vesperis. Robes for Vespers specially made for Lemuen. May her pure light be as the twilight stars, granting all a blessing of peace amidst the interplay of light and shadow.

description: 你即是无辜者的光，你即是有罪者的夜，你虽行于大地，却是天穹之威。
dialog: 斗争血脉系列/天穹肇始。危难与困境从来都不会只停留在某个瞬间，真正的卫士守护着永恒交替的昼夜，一刻不休。信仰搅拌机，正为此而生。

description: Electrical signals flow around her endlessly. These fundamental laws of the game world, she perceives, and she manipulates.
dialog: Achievement Star Collection/Lorem Ipsum. Raidian's character in the alpha test of 'Dark Age of Terra'. The witch floats leisurely past the valley, her giant unrendered companion the incarnation of her awesome might.

description: 当披肩搭在肩上时，受邀出演的云青萍才意识到这身衣服承载的重量。他举起提灯，摆出儿时所见演员的动作，台下便是满堂彩。
dialog: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/照寰瀛。百灶的裁衣师傅为炎国经典戏曲所制的戏服。繁复而典雅的剪裁，配合一盏盈盈的提灯，更显节日之厚重。

description: 欢乐之日的夜空如同底绒一般低调、隐蔽和温暖。Miss.Christine悄然出场，俘获一众目光。今夜被邀请的均是优雅之士，请务必注意，不要使用闪光灯。
dialog: EPOQUE系列新款/底绒舞会。Miss.Christine出席晚间舞会时的装扮。朦胧轻纱搭配金色星芒挂饰，将其优雅慵懒的气质展露无遗。

description: 他面对着铳口露出微笑，但那嘴角之后藏着的究竟是从容还是无奈，就连他自己都无从知晓。
dialog: 忒斯特收藏系列/暮时宝光。森内彻获得了无数财富，却最终步入孤独时的着装。修身西装搭配金紫色内衬的外套，虽然华贵气质外显，却藏不住内心的疲惫。

description: Flametail likes playing games, because the rules are reasonable and don't change at the last minute.
dialog: Achievement Star Collection/Sport For All. Sporty outfit worn by Flametail when playing VR games. The limited space is made even more cramped by the gaming equipment, but she has a great time nonetheless.

description: A single instant here is countless days outside. Let the jeweled box she holds tell you the ending of the dream.
dialog: Iteration Provident/Stranded in Utopia. Haruka's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Following the Goldfins' guidance, she presses on toward the sound of the temari song, finally beholding the princess waiting for visitors in the deepest reaches of utopia.

description: 夜色无边，永不停歇的喧嚷自头脑中远去。群星各归其位，万物各湮其声，而她终于在这全然陌生的寂静里，第一次真正沉睡，也第一次真正醒来。
dialog: 错位巡礼新定义[第零位相/PhaseZero]系列特别款/万籁俱寂。靛蓝之宫的内殿里，雅致的服饰下，是无需言语便可让谒见者知晓前路的深邃之智。

description: 采撷一缕氤氲香雾，存入篮中，让它陪伴你从雪原走向山川湖泊。等你驻足歇息时，会发现篮中艾叶尚青，水露未干。
dialog: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/撷香霭。以炎国产出的绸缎制成的传统踏青服装。在寒冷北地长大的人，也能感受到仲夏云雾的温暖氛围。

description: Be careful not to slip, stretch before entering the water, and swim properly. The gentle voice in the air helps newcomers find their way in the pool.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA210. Brings out a girl’s figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer’s hottest trend.

description: 政宗最近的兴趣是用泰拉的食材研究全新的兔团子配方，至于成果，看义经的表情就知道了。
dialog: 《怪物猎人》合作服装/露营时间喵！为喜欢在山野林间活动的隐秘队量身定做的服装，活动性和透气性极佳。

description: 真正的荣光无需仰望，慷慨公正的太阳将它洒向每一个人。
dialog: 女神异闻录3 Reload合作服装/见证荣光。结城理在校园戏剧节上演出时穿着的服装。拒绝审判的执行者走出殿堂，等待他的是自由与真正的荣光。

description: 有的答案足可追寻一生，是一日日清晨的浇灌与惦念让它长成。
dialog: 女神异闻录3 Reload合作服装/静思真谛。埃癸斯在校园戏剧节上演出时穿着的服装。修士的生活漫长平静，她观察植物的生长，寻觅一个未知问题为何的答案。

description: 朝暮晨昏，云流风转，白墙将许多温热的生活围拢，那就叫做城市。
dialog: 女神异闻录3 Reload合作服装/戍卫晨昏。岳羽由加莉在校园戏剧节上演出时穿着的服装。戍卫队员在白墙顶端远眺，安宁的暮色是她在漫长旅途后获得的奖赏。

description: 'Hi, are you there? Can you hear me, Maggy? This is Aurora! I made it to the summit!'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Polar Catcher. The nations of Terra collectively sent a dozen or so survey groups to scale Sami's perilous peaks. Only Team Aurora funded by Karlan Trade Co. ultimately scaled the summits without hassle, planting their flags and beacons at the peaks.

description: 他们都做着梦中之梦，醒来时嘴角犹噙着微笑，这便是一场好眠。
dialog: 女神异闻录3 Reload合作服装/飞越甜蜜之城。虎狼丸在拉特兰时常穿着的服装。全城的甜品都飞上了天空，围绕着虎狼丸，殷切盼望他能尝上一口——什么，是梦？！

description: 如同金色的光芒一般驱散迷雾的不是剑，不是盾，也不是法杖，而是她们内心深处的善良。
dialog: 小马宝莉合作服装/善良坚强之心。她们都有软弱、害怕的时候，但是她们最终一定会挺身而出，为了重要之人付出自己的全部。

description: Everybody knows Blemishine isn't cut out to be the bad guy, but isn't that what makes it fun? Anyway, she and her family there are just out to have fun, they're not in it to win or lose.
dialog: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Horrorlair's Enigma' Custom Line/Moon Catastrborn. The actor plays the role of the heir of bane who descends upon Terra after rending the moon into twins. The hero stands no chance in a head-on fight.

description: Hailing from a fiery country, a heart of boiling blood mixed with the frigid cold. When wind and snow meet, all must seek safe haven.
dialog: Carnelian's winter outfit in Leithanien / Hohenlohe Chillysand. A traditional Leithanian women's trenchcoat with a pair of animal skin shawls and fleece gloves. Fear not the cold.

description: Sandstorms should be no blanket presence this season, so she's curbing her temper for the time being and making friends with the tame pools of water. It's a fair thing, all told.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SD08. Tight-fitting, lightweight, breathable, and designed for the summer.

description: He wanted to see with his own eyes the side of Siracusa that was not so Siracusan. When he noticed the gazes of those assessing him from the corners of the restaurant, he realized that such a Siracusa does not yet exist.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/The Other Side of Siracusa. Does he not occasionally wear a plain jacket and hoodie instead of a tailored suit, and sit-down at a not-quite traditional Siracusan restaurant?

description: She wants to catch the song of her homeland on the wind, but it always slips through her fingertips.
dialog: 0011 Tempest Series/Hear the Wind Sing. New concept based on the theme of Wind, a collaborative work between multiple designers. The ever-present floating ribbons capture the shape of the wind.

description: But of that moonless night, only these clothes and the lady of a lance born remained presentable. Everything else had taken on terrible, pitch-black forms.
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Lances of Kaliskas. Ashlock's formalwear, worn when her family banished her. Traditional dress worthy of a Kazimierz knight, not entirely inappropriate on her.

description: In screaming winds, all tremble mute. A dead branch tip, a drop of red.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Tremble Cold. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, the typical clothing assembly process was refined in accordance with Ægir bodily characteristics, and the outfit displays a uniquely streamlined effect in turn. Color choices are made independently by the client.

description: Everyone unanimously agreed that Whisperain's character card was scarily well put together, and she herself looks shockingly fitting... Is this really her first time playing this game?
dialog: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Dominions & Dogma' Custom Line/Priory of Abyss. This player shall be the sister in black, who has saved countless adventurers' lives. The people never ask who forgets the traumas of their mundane lives for them.

description: Like many other children, the first time Mizuki found a game he liked, his childhood was only just beginning. It was a naive wish, but he too once hoped these simple joys would never end.
dialog: Achievement Star Collection/A Player Forever. Outfit Mizuki wears when he plays games in Higashi. A perfect fusion of stylish street fashion and retro game elements, letting Mizuki show off his gamer style at max settings.

description: Summer, a party, an uneventful life, a drink in one hand, and a game in the other. What else can be called happiness?
dialog: Test Collection Series/Summer Feast. Mizuki wears this when feasting on the beach. The material is stain-resistant and provides plenty of room for extra appendages.

description: Pinecone is about to leave that small town once more. Knowing his daughter no longer has to worry about the future, the laborer suddenly stuffs a doll into her hands. She stares at it in a daze, but luckily the little guy waves a hand in her stead.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Season of Travel. Pinecone's outfit while visiting family in Columbia. The jacket's jade trim outlines the simple dress with a vibrant aura. An unintentional pairing, yet perfect for spring.

description: A light-hearted nursery rhyme with simple lyrics that you never get tired of, no matter how many times you sing.
dialog: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Sing a Song. After passing her audition, Pinecone took to the stage with no especially strong desire to be an idol. She just wants to sing.

description: Here, far from the vagaries of human emotion, Windscoot forgets all those worldly struggles between good and evil and cracks open a cold can of soda. On this summer's day, he learns what is meant by content relaxation.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Cloud in Foreign Lands. Clothes Windscoot wears while enjoying a solo trip in faraway lands during a break from work. A comfy short-sleeved shirt paired with lightweight sneakers allows him to enjoy this moment of relaxing freedom.

description: Spread out the picnic blanket, set down the honey and lemonade, and next, let the bubbles she blows keep dancing in the gentle breeze.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Picnic Times. Clothes Aroma wore for a picnic. Light, elegant flower-shaped white trim paired with a denim apron makes the girl under the sunlight especially charming.

description: Within fledgling dreams leer cruelty unfit for such an age, but Honeyberry's mother is so glad to see the courage still there, still alive in her girl.
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Wildness Behind. The clothes Honeyberry envisioned during her studies as she described her own prospects to her sickly mother, their intricacies drawn from her mother's wardrobe.

description: The gentle showers soak the city's green leaves bold. The rainbow half up the mount shines on village old.
dialog: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Saturated Within Rain. Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, matching a scene of beauty and wonder recorded in an ancient tome. Remember to bring a paper umbrella, for within, the drops of ink now fall as gentle rains.

description: O lost traveler, no longer must you waver before the unseen roads ahead. Follow in her footsteps, and look towards her light.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/As Clear As Crystal. Necrass's dress for the musical. The inner lining bedecked with stars is the abyss of the past, the radiant outer surface the resolute present. Through crystal and steel, her will carries on.

description: The starlit sky reflects on the waves, while ashen bones scare away souls.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA161. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: The movies tell us that there are three types of people in the world: the good, the bad, and the ugly. But as Robin knows, you don't judge a book by its cover.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Gift of Wild. The choice of the Columbian pioneer, with a core emphasis on strong and durable design. The added details give this outfit that extra personal touch.

description: 'Whoever drew the privilege of getting to play with Peacake for a day... Remember to bring them back tomorrow!'
dialog: Beanstalk's personally coordinated casualwear / Gift Uncompleted. An off-white knitted sweater paired with light-green silk pajamas for a low-key aesthetic. When in the company of friends, comfort is the highest priority.

description: There are plenty of ribbons for Peacake to play with, but the one actually bound by an eternal vow, she grasps tightly in her hand.
dialog: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Ribbons of Promise. Dress Beanstalk wore to the holiday party. A trailing dress of pure white is punctuated by a beautiful red, the fluttering ribbons highlighting the girl's vibrant charm.

description: He presses down his bamboo hat, the scenery of his hometown becoming a silhouette behind him.
dialog: 0011 New Release / Pale Rising Moon. Inspired by the outfits Mr. Nothing uses to conceal others, with an improved design. Just as the moon waxes and wanes, some people occasionally decide to break character and act debonair.

description: The best way to get to know a group of people is to blend in.
dialog: Rainbow Six Collab Series/Ranger. This outfit, hand-picked by Ash herself, emphasizes both disguisability and sportiness. A specially-made hat conceals Ash's identity, facilitating intelligence-gathering and related work.

description: To rule is to merely protect.
dialog: Rainbow Six Collab Series/Lord. A set of tactical armor that consists of the helmet Tachanka picked from the Lord of Long Spring's collection and a modified set of standard issue battle armor. It has exceptional defensive capabilities, which is further topped off with an imposing appearance that can be seen from afar.

description: This is the first time Shana Moleman has left Rim Billiton. She takes off her hard hat for a moment. A survey drone flies high in the sky. This time, it illuminates more than just the darkness of the mineshaft.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/New Business. Cement's survey consultant outfit. Snug and durable, the contrast of the hoodie and jacket brings out her vitality. She also gets herself a pair of goggles to match with them.

description: The specialties Qanipalaat hands out are often eccentric. Other operators may not be able to appreciate the terrifying dried totems or the pungent fermented food, but they recognize a gesture of friendship from an ancient civilization.
dialog: Formal wear that Qanipalaat received while on holiday/Gratitude Gift. Always one to gift Sami specialties, he's now received a gift in return. He smiled to learn that Victorian garb went well with his tail.

description: A serene day, the moon in her teacup, surrounded by indulgent flowers... It is rather difficult for Indigo to understand this scenery.
dialog: 0011 New Release / Serene Day. Handmade in Lungmen. The fabric is light and comfortable, using the client's favorite purple color as a base and embellished with dark lines. Casual yet dignified, it is perfect for all sorts of occasions.

description: Perhaps due to Old Isin's influence, on occasion both Elliot and Passenger find themselves deep in a dream—one of what is to come, the other of what has been...
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Dream In A Moment. Two sets of clothing held in Passenger's memories and casually put to paper, then realized as outfits by a snooping Operator.

description: From seeding to harvest, Mulberry pays careful attention to every detail of her herbs.
dialog: EPOQUE Series New Release/Plant Crude Drug. Practical outfit worn by Mulberry for both relief and horticultural work, with enough pockets for all her tools. Green trimmings adorn the simple fabric, representing verdant life.

description: A drop of water on the lotus path, the full moon shining alongside the lantern.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Reflection That of the Moons. Made by Lungmen tailors, inspired by the waterscapes of Jiangqi, the delicate cuts and soft gauze represent the reflection of the lotus in water when the moon is out.

description: 'My fellow Ægir, no longer does the sea lies behind us. We have no other choice.'
dialog: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Return. Ægir Consul Gladiia's attire as she led her unit to return to the sea. Following sufficient exchange with the nations of dry land, the Ægir found themselves fully prepared to return to the home they'd left.

description: She may prefer the classics, but even she is not immune to change. At her team's recommendation, she changes her wardrobe and hair once more. There is no trace of coldness in her step, and her every movement is graceful, as she always has been.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/I Am the Tides. An outfit Gladiia often wears. With the tides, she comes and goes freely between land and sea. The hunter is at ease, for the hunter is the tide.

description: Swordplay lives not in books, but reading makes a general nimble of mind. Cling not to the cherry blossoms, nor to the sharpest edge.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Temperament. Adroit tailoring and a rich modern sense for color, contrasted with accessories detailed with classical appeal. Spectacles are custom-made as a gift by the brand, for the client.

description: The touch of the spring breeze brushes the blossoms on the branches. The touch of wine brushes the furrowed brow.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Fragrance From the Branches. Clean-cut, form-fitting skirt, given an extra touch with matching accessories. The soft felt jacket keeps the wearer warm in the chill of early spring.

description: Light and Cart are engrossed in scoffing lotus seeds, and Helmet and Drill are piled atop each other for a nap. Blacknight's mind is far away, most likely reminiscing on summer in the barrens.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA641. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: “刚才去的那家三色冰淇淋店真不错，把照片发给宴，有机会和她一起再去一次吧！”
dialog: EPOQUE系列新款/轻闲快照。绮良前往御机城街头游玩时的着装。舒适的针织背心，吸睛的迷你裙，还有可爱的多彩发饰，这张快照一定大受好评。

description: Bringing this stuff to Rhodes Island cost Kirara a pretty penny, but the number of times she's requested leave since then proves it was worth it.
dialog: Achievement Star Collection/Trendsetting Player. A gift from the devs, thrown in when Kirara bought a complete set of gaming equipment. Customized just for her, a loose and comfortable outfit for around the home.

description: War has taken its last breath. Blood and steel have been overgrown by vegetation, and bright flowers bloom in place of hate.
dialog: EPOQUE Series New Release/Appreciate Fragrance. Finely-crafted Victorian dress, handmade from the finest materials. An elegant and dignified outfit bound to garner attention anywhere.

description: She hopes for a day where everyone can have the right to freely enjoy the beach and sun.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA317. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

description: The pale models are lifeless, but the brushes and paints in her hand can give them a soul.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Granter of Colors. Roberta's work outfit. With the other operators' help and encouragement, Roberta finally found the time to design a look for herself as well.

description: The waves brush away both her makeup and her troubles. If beauty requires decoration, then the ocean itself is embellishment enough for her.
dialog: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA374. Brings out a girl’s figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer’s hottest trend.

description: 'What we've inherited is much more than just these outfits, but the ideology, the principles, and the future as well.'
dialog: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Heritage. Traditional Minoan ritual attire, coordinated with modern themes, is once again in vogue among Minoans.

skinName.en: A Drip of Orea and Potamous

description: The drunken traveler walks her homeland's mountains and rivers. A new epic is poured into the temple that the twelve heroes retook.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Drip of Orea and Potamous. Designed for the climate of Minos, slim-fitting and easy to move in. The fabric is durable, waterproof, and resistant to the occasional spilled wine. Can be customized with extras to the customer's needs.

description: In Tequila's hands, every card is a trump card, and in that respect, he's a resident professional.
dialog: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Cardwinner. Tequila's formal stage outfit. Qualified hosts heat up the audience; excellent hosts strive to eliminate any errant possibility.

description: Though it was his first audition, Tequila's score shot far past the competition. The other idol wannabes wanted to ask how to be as charming as him, but within minutes found themselves won over by his smile and joining his fan club.
dialog: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Top Tier Live. Always with a shining smile, a gentlemanly attitude, and impressive skills. Only just on stage, and Tequila's already mesmerized the crowd.

description: Fruit cake. A quiet, relaxing mealtime. And a calming hug.
dialog: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Heartwarming Baking. Sure, it might look a little messy, with a few things not going as planned along the way. But he will serve the cake to you with a smile all the same, just like the life he wishes to lead, one filled with an affectionate warmth.

description: The sun hasn't set quite yet, and the night breeze blows across the city, the refreshing wind taking away her worries and sorrows for the moment.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/To Rest in Night Breezes. Siesta welcomes back any and all weary wanderers. Fresh-off-the-truck Ann-Maier puts on her favorite ensemble to hit the beach, taking in the quiet sands as day turns to night.

description: 'I figured the acidity is suitably... corrosive? Please, as if I'd be boring enough to talk about work on such a nice spring afternoon! I meant this can of soda.'
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Leisure. The season's latest leisurewear in Columbia. Detachable straps and pouches let Corroserum show off the many delights of his spring travels.

description: In the past, he would sweat as he struggled to survive, but now, at this blazing street corner, only joy and hope flows.
dialog: MARTHE Sports Line/Blazing Street View. Avant-garde clothes made for urban life. Lightweight and sweat-wicking yet durable fabrics help the wearer show off their street style.

description: Five people enter an alley, one leaves alive. From here on, home is a distant thing, and the rootless trees are set to drift alone.
dialog: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Distant Home's Guide. The plainclothes Quercus once wore on an infiltration mission. Principally serving to conceal her identity, so as to better facilitate combat in city environs.

description: There are many who believe themselves dashing and humorous, more than enough to take on the role of a wandering bard, but Quercus's improvised performance is not something just anyone can learn.
dialog: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Dominions & Dogma' Custom Line/The Bard's Tale. This player shall be the one singing ballads for the heroes of old, livening up the tavern with her ditties. Come, listen close, who stole the melody that wends through the shadow-flickering breeze?

description: “找到她……保护她。”迷宫的园丁把守着唯一的出口，盔甲下的蔷薇花苞始终指着那位公主所在的方向。
dialog: 成就之星系列/蔷薇之谜。刺玫为电玩展的参展游戏《翡绿迷宫》拍摄海报时的着装。她所扮演的公主完成了授剑礼，蔷薇骑士自此拥有了一颗翡绿之心。

description: Be it the remodeling of her 'Justice Knight' or the future of her Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, she's overflowing with confidence.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Justice Maker. Attire of Wild Mane during repairs of 'Justice Knight.' Cozy and breathable, while wear and stain resistant. Detailing and accessories in contrasting colors coordinated to embody that sense of planning.

description: As Cantabile's slender fingers pluck at the strings, a melodious song begins to play across the lake. Her holiday is not a long one, but at the very least, at this very moment, she wants to forget it all, and allow herself to soak in the tranquility.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bard by the Lake. Attire Cantabile wore during her lakeside holiday. The white of the dress is in perfect harmony with the natural environment, creating a tranquil, dream-like ambience.

description: Coolness of spring, touching the flames of life; warm evening breeze, touching the cheek's silver flower.
dialog: 0011 New Arrivals/Illumination That of Daylights. Made by Lungmen tailors. The gauze lining at the hem softens the lines, as does the matching white shawl.

description: Coupons, donuts! A food festival's not complete without some real dessert, right?
dialog: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Sweet Jackpot. You can't win the sweets competition by wearing a uniform! Insider put this on before diving head-first into the bakery, and he's about to present his creation. Don't worry, the sweetness has been adjusted to suit your tastes.

description: 难得的夏日假期里这些东西必不可少：吊床、杂志，还有一杯二十分甜的消暑汽水。
dialog: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣25男款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description: Now that everything has been laid bare and the plan has run through his mind countless times, he knows what he must do next.
dialog: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sun Slant. After sorting through his attic, Diamante finally pieced together a web connecting the nobles to the mining accident twenty years ago. As he rubs his aching neck, the sunlight seeps in through the window.
